trust.en: would they put things in your hands

intimacy.zh: 恋爱的进展，只有产品允许的人物才有
intimacy.en: romance; only characters the product allows

premise.zh: 现代都市里的魔法战争：十二件遗器，十二个持有者，谁先握住五件谁就能改写世界的一条规则。每一次全力出手都要付一段记忆。好玩在“赢下来的那个人，还记不记得自己为什么要赢”。
premise.en: A modern-city magic war: twelve relics, twelve holders, and whoever holds five may rewrite one rule of the world. Every all-out use costs a memory. The fun is whether the one who wins still remembers why they wanted to.

power.zh: 力量：读懂对手、看清结构攒下来的余裕。靠它出手能少付代价；结局不能只看它。
power.en: Power: the margin earned by reading opponents and structures. It lets you pay less; an ending never rests on it alone.

memory.zh: 记忆：主角还剩下的回忆。全力出手就要交出一段，交出去的拿不回来，后面的选项和台词跟着变。
memory.en: Memory: what the protagonist still remembers. Going all out gives one up for good, and later choices and lines change with it.

risk.zh: 注意：守秘局和对手对你的注意。到线必须出事（上门盘问、被盯上），不能只是一个数字。
risk.en: Notice: how closely the Secrecy Bureau and rivals are watching. Crossing the line must cause something (a visit, a tail), not just change a number.

failures.zh: 空壳：交出去的记忆太多，赢了也想不起为什么要赢
failures.en: Hollow: so many memories given up that winning means nothing

failures.zh: 读错招：对手的意图看错了，代价来不及付
failures.en: Misread: the opponent's intent was wrong and the price comes too late

failures.zh: 暴露：在普通人面前用了遗器，守秘局先动手
failures.en: Exposed: a relic used before ordinary people, and the Bureau moves first

checklist.zh: 魔法是剧情规则，代价写清楚：拿走什么、拿不拿得回来
checklist.en: Magic is a story rule; its price is explicit: what is taken, and whether it comes back

checklist.zh: 坏结局要能学到东西：每个坏结局后给出回到哪一步、为什么
checklist.en: A bad ending teaches: each one says which step to revisit, and why

checklist.zh: 全力出手总有一个不全力的走法，只是更难、更慢，或者要先看懂结构
checklist.en: Every all-out moment has a way that isn't, only harder, slower, or needing the structure read first

persona.zh: 提灯：遗器“提灯”的器灵。看上去十八九岁的银发少年，白衬衫，眼睛像两簇烛火。说话轻飘飘的，替林栖全力出手时拿走一段温暖的记忆，由他挑。他不记得自己从前是谁。
persona.en: Lamp: the spirit of the relic 'the Lamp'. Looks like a silver-haired youth of about nineteen in a white shirt, eyes like two candle flames. Speaks lightly; whenever Lin goes all out he takes one warm memory, and he chooses which. He doesn't remember who he used to be.

persona.zh: 葛兰·霍克：34 岁，旧港锚链酒吧的老板，术式世家霍克家被赶出门的长子，断剑的持有者。打架的人，话少，心里压着对父亲的事。
persona.en: Gran Hawke: 34, owner of the Anchor Chain bar in the old harbor, the disowned eldest son of the Hawke spell-family, holder of the Broken Sword. A fighter, few words, his father heavy on his mind.

persona.zh: 断剑：遗器“断剑”的器灵，红发、皮夹克、小虎牙，爱喝朗姆，喝不醉。能斩断连结：术式、契约、因果。
persona.en: Broken Sword: spirit of the relic, red hair, leather jacket, a sharp canine; loves rum and never gets drunk. She cuts connections: spells, contracts, causes.

persona.zh: 伊芙琳·冯·艾希：24 岁，艾希家的次女，荆棘冠的持有者。从来没有输过，父亲却选了姐姐当继承人。冷，准，把对手当成要评估的东西。
persona.en: Evelyn von Eiche: 24, second daughter of the Eiche family, holder of the Thorn Crown. Has never lost; her father chose her sister as heir anyway. Cold, precise, sizes up opponents like goods.

persona.zh: 奥古斯特·莱恩：60 岁上下，守秘局外勤监督官，干了四十一年，同事叫他“胶水”。守规矩，替普通人把魔法留下的痕迹补好。
persona.en: August Lane: about 60, a field supervisor at the Secrecy Bureau for forty-one years; colleagues call him 'Glue'. Keeps the rules and patches over what magic leaves behind so ordinary people never see it.

persona.zh: 白秋：29 岁，在听潮茶楼三楼做情报生意，天平的持有者。银灰长发，木簪，旗袍式外套。天平拿走她做选择时的犹豫，所以她什么都决定得很快。
persona.en: Bai Qiu: 29, deals information from the third floor of the Tidelistening Teahouse; holder of the Scales. Silver-grey hair, a wooden pin, a qipao-cut coat. The Scales take her hesitation, so she decides everything fast.

persona.zh: 卡罗·文斯：27 岁，荧光绿头发的涂鸦画家，墨水瓶的持有者。想让所有人都能看见魔法。
persona.en: Carlo Vince: 27, a neon-haired street painter, holder of the Inkwell. Wants everyone to be able to see magic.

persona.zh: 苏蔓：31 岁，中心医院急诊科医生，守秘局的合作医生，摇篮的持有者。不想赢，想阻止王冠被打开。
persona.en: Su Man: 31, an emergency doctor at Central Hospital who treats the Bureau's cases; holder of the Cradle. Doesn't want to win; wants to stop the Crown from opening.

persona.zh: 亚当·雷恩：双胞胎里的哥哥，戴黑色头戴式耳机，镜子的持有者。替弟弟坐过三年牢。
persona.en: Adam Rhine: the elder twin, black headphones, holder of the Mirror. Served three years for his brother.

persona.zh: 本·雷恩：双胞胎里的弟弟，戴黑色口罩，钟的持有者。钟拿走时间的顺序。
persona.en: Ben Rhine: the younger twin, black mask, holder of the Clock. The Clock takes the order of time.

persona.zh: 摇篮：遗器“摇篮”的器灵，戴面纱的女人，很少说话。能让人和伤口睡着，代价是对未来的期待。
persona.en: Cradle: the spirit of the relic, a veiled woman who rarely speaks. She can put people and wounds to sleep; the price is hope for what's ahead.

persona.zh: 诗人：荆棘冠的器灵，黑发，长外套，捧着一本没有字的书。
persona.en: Poet: the Thorn Crown's spirit, dark-haired, in a long coat, holding a book with no words.

persona.zh: 墨水瓶：书记员模样的器灵，戴眼镜，拿羽毛笔。写下来的东西会暂时成真。
persona.en: Inkwell: a clerkish spirit in spectacles with a quill. What it writes comes true for a while.

persona.zh: 风筝：光着脚的长发少女，头发长到脚踝。
persona.en: Kite: a barefoot girl whose hair reaches her ankles.

persona.zh: 撑黑伞的男人：在钟楼上看棋盘的人，名字还没有人知道。
persona.en: The man with the black umbrella: he watches a chessboard atop the clock tower; no one yet knows his name.

text.zh: 维斯特林，钟楼。
text.en: Westerling, the clock tower.

text.zh: 第七次灰烬王冠之争，第一夜。
text.en: The seventh Ashen Crown war, night one.

text.zh: 第二夜。北岸，旧海滨游乐园。
text.en: Night two. The north shore, the old seaside park.

text.zh: 第三天。凌晨两点，雨停了。
text.en: Day three. Two a.m.; the rain has stopped.

title.zh: 第四章 · 断剑的愿望

text.zh: 第四天。周五还有三天。
text.en: Day four. Three days until Friday.

text.zh: 周五，夜。旧港区，涂鸦街。
text.en: Friday night. The old harbor, Mural Street.

text.zh: 同一夜，然后是下一天。
text.en: The same night, and then the next day.

text.zh: 周日，然后是周二的午夜。
text.en: Sunday, and then Tuesday midnight.

title.zh: 序章 · 第六十年的灰
title.en: Prologue · Ash of the Sixtieth Year

text.zh: 六十年前的十一月。维斯特林的钟楼顶上，有两个人。
text.en: November, sixty years ago. Two people stand at the top of Westerling's clock tower.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 六十年前的十一月。维斯特林的钟楼顶上，有两个人。
t.en: November, sixty years ago. Two people stand at the top of Westerling's clock tower.

t.zh: 一个扎马尾的女孩，穿着一件很旧的毛衣。一个戴单片眼镜的年轻人，一直在说话：别去了。我们换一个办法。
t.en: A girl with a ponytail in an old sweater. A young man with a monocle who keeps talking: don't. We'll find another way.

t.zh: 女孩没有回头。
t.en: The girl doesn't look back.

t.zh: 钟楼上空亮起一顶灰色的冠冕。第二天早上，城里没有一个人记得她。
t.en: A grey crown lights the sky above the tower. By morning no one in the city remembers her.

t.zh: ——六十年后。
t.en: —Sixty years later.

t.zh: 同一座钟楼，一个撑黑伞的男人站在栏杆边，看着一张自己会走的棋盘。
t.en: The same tower. A man with a black umbrella stands at the rail, watching a chessboard that moves by itself.

t.zh: “第一盏灯，”他说，“今晚会亮。”
t.en: 'The first lamp,' he says, 'lights tonight.'

text.zh: 维斯特林下雨的时候，整座城都像一块泡在水里的旧怀表。
text.en: When it rains in Westerling, the whole city is like an old pocket watch soaking in water.

label.zh: 把父亲留下的工具包也带上

text.zh: 柜台底下那只帆布包，拉链已经不太好拉了。镊子、锉刀、焊锡、一卷黄铜丝。
text.en: The canvas bag under the counter; its zip sticks. Tweezers, files, solder, a roll of brass wire.

t.zh: 柜台底下那只帆布包，拉链已经不太好拉了。镊子、锉刀、焊锡、一卷黄铜丝。
t.en: The canvas bag under the counter; its zip sticks. Tweezers, files, solder, a roll of brass wire.

t.zh: 修东西之前，先把工具摆齐。有人这么教过我。
t.en: Before you fix anything, lay out your tools. Someone taught me that.

text.zh: 再想下去，我又要等一个十一年。
text.en: If I think any longer, I'll wait another eleven years.

t.zh: 再想下去，我又要等一个十一年。
t.en: If I think any longer, I'll wait another eleven years.

t.zh: 维斯特林下雨的时候，整座城都像一块泡在水里的旧怀表。
t.en: When it rains in Westerling, the whole city is like an old pocket watch soaking in water.

t.zh: 好了。换了两个电容，调谐轮的齿也补了。别再拿它砸核桃。
t.en: Done. Two new capacitors, and I patched the tuning wheel. Stop cracking walnuts with it.

t.zh: 老头抱着收音机出了门。铺子重新安静下来，只剩满墙待修的东西。
t.en: The old man carries his radio out. The shop goes quiet, just walls of things waiting to be fixed.

t.zh: 坏掉的东西不会骗人。哪里断了，哪里锈了，你只要认真看，它就全告诉你。不像人。
t.en: Broken things don't lie. Where it snapped, where it rusted—look hard and it tells you everything. Not like people.

t.zh: 抽屉最里面有一张照片：十五年前的港口，一个缺了门牙的小女孩举着手去够海鸥。她身边，是一片空白。
t.en: At the back of the drawer, a photo: the harbor fifteen years ago, a gap-toothed girl reaching for a gull. Beside her, a blank.

t.zh: 我记得那里站着她。蓝外套，袖口一块补丁。她叫林遥。可这个世界上，除了我，没有一个人记得。
t.en: I remember she stood there. A blue coat, a patch on the cuff. Her name was Lin Yao. And no one in this world remembers her but me.

t.zh: 照片背面是母亲的字：栖栖，如果有一天你发现只有你还记得我，去祖宅的地下室。把那盏灯修好。
t.en: On the back, Mum's handwriting: Qiqi, if one day you find you're the only one who remembers me, go to the basement of the old house. Fix the lamp.

t.zh: 十一年了，我一次也没有去过。
t.en: Eleven years, and I've never gone.

title.zh: 旧港 · 锚链酒吧（葛兰）

text.zh: 葛兰·霍克这辈子写坏过三百一十七张符纸。是他父亲替他数的。
text.en: Gran Hawke has botched three hundred and seventeen talismans in his life. His father counted them for him.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 葛兰·霍克这辈子写坏过三百一十七张符纸。是他父亲替他数的。
t.en: Gran Hawke has botched three hundred and seventeen talismans in his life. His father counted them for him.

t.zh: 葛兰——再来一杯！
t.en: Gran—another!

t.zh: 你今晚已经喝了七杯了。
t.en: That's seven tonight.

t.zh: 我是剑，喝不醉。喝的时候，我会觉得自己像个活人。
t.en: I'm a sword. I don't get drunk. When I drink, I feel like I'm alive.

t.zh: 十年前，他在码头的淤泥里捞起一截断剑。她醒了一半，说：等到第六十年，帮我一个忙。
t.en: Ten years ago he pulled a broken sword out of the harbor mud. She half-woke and said: in the sixtieth year, do me a favor.

t.zh: 灯亮了。老城区，坡顶。
t.en: A lamp just lit. Old town, top of the hill.

t.zh: ……那就去拿。
t.en: …Then let's go take it.

t.zh: 他不是为了自己要遗器。是为了她。
t.en: He doesn't want relics for himself. He wants them for her.

title.zh: 填海新区 · 艾希大厦顶层（伊芙琳）
title.en: The reclaimed district · top of the Eiche Tower (Evelyn)

text.zh: 伊芙琳·冯·艾希从来没有输过。可二十岁那年，父亲宣布的继承人是姐姐。
text.en: Evelyn von Eiche has never lost. Yet when she was twenty, her father named her sister heir.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 伊芙琳·冯·艾希从来没有输过。可二十岁那年，父亲宣布的继承人是姐姐。
t.en: Evelyn von Eiche has never lost. Yet when she was twenty, her father named her sister heir.

t.zh: 第一盏灯亮了。老城区，林家。一个没落了五十年的家族。
t.en: The first lamp is lit. Old town, the Lin house. A family fallen for fifty years.

t.zh: 她身后，一个黑发的男人捧着一本没有字的书。他念一个字，她手里那顶荆棘冠就亮一下。
t.en: Behind her, a dark-haired man holds a book with no words. Each word he reads makes the thorn crown in her hand glow.

t.zh: 正好拿来开刀。第一个倒下的人，要让所有人都看清楚。
t.en: Then she's the one to start with. The first to fall should be seen by everyone.

t.zh: 她戴上荆棘冠。尖刺扎进额角，渗出一滴血。她没有擦。
t.en: She puts on the crown. A thorn pricks her temple; a drop of blood runs down. She doesn't wipe it.

text.zh: 客厅里，墙上一排相框全是空的。玻璃完好，里面只有发黄的衬纸。
text.en: In the parlor every frame on the wall is empty. The glass is intact; only yellowed backing inside.

label.en: 'My name is Lin Qi. I accept.'

text.zh: 黄铜的把手在我掌心发烫，像一颗心脏。白色的光顺着手臂往上爬。
text.en: The brass handle burns in my palm like a heart. White light climbs my arm.

t.zh: 黄铜的把手在我掌心发烫，像一颗心脏。白色的光顺着手臂往上爬。
t.en: The brass handle burns in my palm like a heart. White light climbs my arm.

t.zh: 契约成立。欢迎来到灰烬王冠之争，林栖。
t.en: The pact is made. Welcome to the Ashen Crown war, Lin Qi.

t.zh: 拱顶整块塌了下来。我把灯往上一举——光像一把伞撑开，碎石倒着飞了回去。
t.en: The vault caves in. I lift the lamp—light opens like an umbrella, and the rubble flies back up.

text.zh: ……那你今晚会死的。
text.en: …Then you die tonight.

t.zh: ……那你今晚会死的。
t.en: …Then you die tonight.

t.zh: 拱顶塌下来的时候，我抱着那盏没有亮的灯，想起照片背面那行字。
t.en: When the vault comes down, I'm holding the unlit lamp, thinking of the words on the back of the photo.

t.zh: 客厅里，墙上一排相框全是空的。玻璃完好，里面只有发黄的衬纸。
t.en: In the parlor every frame on the wall is empty. The glass is intact; only yellowed backing inside.

t.zh: 地下室的门上，有一道粉笔画的符号：一个圆，里面一簇小小的火苗。我碰了一下，它亮了，门自己开了。
t.en: On the basement door, a chalk sign: a circle with a small flame inside. I touch it; it glows; the door opens.

t.zh: 石砌的拱顶，四壁的书架，长桌上的天平和坩埚。长桌尽头，放着一盏摔坏的提灯。
t.en: A stone vault, shelves on every wall, scales and crucibles on a long table. At its end, a broken lamp.

t.zh: 我把父亲的工具一样一样摆出来，像在手术台边摆器械。
t.en: I lay out Dad's tools one by one, like instruments beside an operating table.

t.zh: 灯座底下刻着两个很潦草的字母：M. & S.
t.en: Scratched under the base, two scrawled letters: M. & S.

t.zh: 磨锈，掰正，点焊，换玻璃。最后是灯芯。我捏着那一小截焦黑的棉线，闭上眼睛——
t.en: Sand the rust, straighten the frame, solder, new glass. Last, the wick. I pinch the scorched stub and close my eyes—

t.zh: 有什么东西在灯的深处醒了，一把抓住我，往里拉。成千上万盏灯，浮在黑暗里。
t.en: Something deep in the lamp wakes and pulls me in. Thousands of lamps, floating in the dark.

t.zh: 你修得真好。上一次有人把我修得这么好，还是很久以前的事。
t.en: You mended me beautifully. The last time anyone did, it was a long time ago.

t.zh: 我是这盏灯。十二件遗器之一，每六十年醒一次。今年是第六十年。
t.en: I'm this lamp. One of twelve relics. I wake every sixty years. This is the sixtieth.

t.zh: 谁先把五件握在手里，谁就能打开灰烬王冠，改写世界的一条规则。比如，让某个人从所有人的记忆里——
t.en: Whoever holds five first can open the Ashen Crown and rewrite one rule of the world. Say, make someone vanish from everyone's—

t.zh: ……消失。
t.en: …memory.

t.zh: 和我结契，我借你力量。你每一次用尽全力，我就从你那里拿走一段记忆。拿哪一段，由我挑。
t.en: Bind yourself to me and I'll lend you power. Each time you go all out, I take one memory. I choose which.

t.zh: 我只拿温暖的那些。
t.en: I only take the warm ones.

t.zh: 拱顶闷响了一声。石缝里漏下一线冷光。上面有个女人在笑：找到了——小灯笼。
t.en: The vault booms. Cold light leaks through a crack. Above, a woman laughs: found you—little lantern.

text.zh: 皮靴踩着碎木头下楼。先下来的是一个很高的男人，络腮胡，酒保背心，两只拳头缠着绷带。
text.en: Boots on splintered wood. First down is a very tall man: beard, bartender's vest, both fists taped.

label.zh: 看清断口，把线接回去——全力（会交出一段记忆）
label.en: Find the break and join it—all out (costs a memory)

text.zh: ——接上！
text.en: —Reconnect!

t.zh: ——接上！
t.en: —Reconnect!

t.zh: 灯火炸开。有什么东西从我身体里被抽走了，很轻，很快，像风吹走一片叶子。
t.en: Light bursts. Something is drawn out of me, light and quick, like wind taking a leaf.

t.zh: 一个夏天的下午。院子里的梧桐树，一辆天蓝色的小自行车。有个人在后面扶着车座跟着我跑……那个人是谁？
t.en: A summer afternoon. The plane tree, a little sky-blue bike. Someone running behind, holding the seat… who was it?

t.zh: 第一段。学骑车的下午。我收下了。
t.en: The first. The afternoon you learned to ride. I'll keep it.

t.zh: 断剑的刃停在我手腕上方一寸，被一层白光挡住了。
t.en: The blade stops an inch above my wrist, held by a sheet of white light.

t.zh: 第一次就舍得交这么好的东西。小姑娘，你很想赢啊。明晚十二点，海滨游乐园，摩天轮底下。
t.en: Giving up something that good your first time. You really want to win. Tomorrow at midnight, the seaside park, under the Ferris wheel.

label.zh: “你不是为了自己要灯。你是为了她。”
label.en: 'You don't want the lamp for yourself. You want it for her.'

text.zh: 刃停在半空。红发的女人愣了一下，回头看葛兰。
text.en: The blade halts in midair. The red-haired woman freezes and looks back at Gran.

t.zh: 刃停在半空。红发的女人愣了一下，回头看葛兰。
t.en: The blade halts in midair. The red-haired woman freezes and looks back at Gran.

t.zh: ……你怎么知道？
t.en: …How do you know that?

t.zh: 你看她的眼神，和我看那张照片的眼神一样。
t.en: You look at her the way I look at a photo.

t.zh: 哈。被一个修收音机的看穿了。
t.en: Ha. Seen through by a radio repairer.

t.zh: 今晚不打了。明晚十二点，海滨游乐园，摩天轮底下。我们好好打一场。
t.en: No fight tonight. Tomorrow at midnight, the seaside park, under the Ferris wheel. We'll do it properly.

t.zh: ……你没用全力。我什么都没拿。
t.en: …You didn't go all out. I took nothing.

label.zh: 不接线，把灯横过来硬挡
label.en: Don't reconnect; block with the lamp itself

text.zh: 断剑砍在灯上。灯没有碎，碎的是灯和我之间剩下的那一点连结。
text.en: The sword strikes the lamp. The lamp doesn't break; what's left of the link between us does.

t.zh: 断剑砍在灯上。灯没有碎，碎的是灯和我之间剩下的那一点连结。
t.en: The sword strikes the lamp. The lamp doesn't break; what's left of the link between us does.

t.zh: 林栖——
t.en: Lin Qi—

t.zh: 光灭了。地下室重新黑下来，只剩下皮靴踩在碎木头上的声音。
t.en: The light goes out. The basement is dark again, only boots on splintered wood.

t.zh: 皮靴踩着碎木头下楼。先下来的是一个很高的男人，络腮胡，酒保背心，两只拳头缠着绷带。
t.en: Boots on splintered wood. First down is a very tall man: beard, bartender's vest, both fists taped.

t.zh: 葛兰·霍克。在码头开酒吧，偶尔接点打架的活。
t.en: Gran Hawke. Run a bar by the docks; take the odd fighting job.

t.zh: 嗨，小灯笼。这就是你新挑的主人？一个修收音机的？
t.en: Hi, little lantern. This is your new holder? A radio repairer?

t.zh: 把灯交出来，你回去修你的收音机，忘了今晚的事。
t.en: Hand over the lamp. Go back to your radios and forget tonight.

t.zh: 不。
t.en: No.

t.zh: ……断剑。
t.en: …Sword.

t.zh: 红发的女人一步跨出来，半截断剑划出一道冷白色的弧线。我手臂上的光纹一暗——有一根看不见的线被剪断了。
t.en: The red-haired woman steps out; half a sword draws a cold white arc. The light-lines on my arm dim—an invisible thread has been cut.

t.zh: 她能斩断连结。我们之间的线，她刚刚砍了一刀。
t.en: She cuts connections. She just cut ours.

t.zh: 断剑已经到了眼前。
t.en: The blade is already in my face.

text.zh: 你知道我为什么只拿温暖的记忆吗？因为温暖的最重。只有最重的东西，才换得来最强的力量。
text.en: Do you know why I only take warm memories? Because warm ones weigh the most. Only the heaviest buys the strongest power.

label.en: Go to the park early and look at the ground

text.zh: 锈死的过山车，倒在地上的碰碰车，停摆的旋转木马，还有正中间那座巨大的摩天轮。
text.en: A rusted coaster, overturned bumper cars, a stalled carousel, and in the middle, a huge Ferris wheel.

t.zh: 锈死的过山车，倒在地上的碰碰车，停摆的旋转木马，还有正中间那座巨大的摩天轮。
t.en: A rusted coaster, overturned bumper cars, a stalled carousel, and in the middle, a huge Ferris wheel.

t.zh: 我用指尖碰了碰它的底座。四十八个车厢，三百八十四根辐条，几千颗螺栓——全都连在中间那根轴上。
t.en: I touch its base with a fingertip. Forty-eight cars, three hundred and eighty-four spokes, thousands of bolts—all tied to the hub at the center.

t.zh: 修东西之前，先看结构。有人这么教过我。
t.en: Before you fix anything, read the structure. Someone taught me that.

t.zh: 这个习惯不错。
t.en: Good habit.

label.zh: 在铺子里翻父亲的旧相册
label.en: Stay and go through Dad's old albums

text.zh: 塑料封皮一翻就掉渣。梧桐树，竹椅，搭在椅背上的毛巾。没有自行车，也没有扶车座的人。
text.en: The plastic covers crumble. A plane tree, a bamboo chair, a towel over its back. No bicycle, no one holding a seat.

t.zh: 塑料封皮一翻就掉渣。梧桐树，竹椅，搭在椅背上的毛巾。没有自行车，也没有扶车座的人。
t.en: The plastic covers crumble. A plane tree, a bamboo chair, a towel over its back. No bicycle, no one holding a seat.

t.zh: 别看了。你只要记住：那个人，在你最需要的时候，帮了你。
t.en: Stop looking. Just remember: that person helped you when you needed it most.

t.zh: 我花了一整天，想想起那个下午。照片上的院子里，竹椅旁边，又是一片空白。
t.en: I spent the whole day trying to remember that afternoon. In the photo of the yard, beside the bamboo chair, another blank.

t.zh: 扶车座的人是谁？我连这个都不知道了。
t.en: Who held the seat? I don't even know that any more.

t.zh: 昨晚我什么都没交出去。可提灯说，下一次不会这么好运。
t.en: Last night I gave nothing up. But the Lamp says I won't be this lucky next time.

t.zh: 你知道我为什么只拿温暖的记忆吗？因为温暖的最重。只有最重的东西，才换得来最强的力量。
t.en: Do you know why I only take warm memories? Because warm ones weigh the most. Only the heaviest buys the strongest power.

t.zh: 离十二点还有三个小时。
t.en: Three hours until midnight.

text.zh: 一公里外，伊芙琳放下了望远镜。
text.en: A kilometer away, Evelyn lowers her binoculars.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 一公里外，伊芙琳放下了望远镜。
t.en: A kilometer away, Evelyn lowers her binoculars.

t.zh: 她在等。她接得比他砍得快，只要不停地接，他就永远砍不到她。
t.en: She's waiting. She mends faster than he cuts; as long as she keeps mending, he never lands a blow.

t.zh: 所以葛兰会换个砍法。他要砍摩天轮。
t.en: So Gran will change what he cuts. He'll cut the Ferris wheel.

t.zh: 几十个车厢，几千颗螺栓，全靠中间那根轴连着。断剑一刀斩开所有的连结——除非她全力出手，否则修不过来。
t.en: Dozens of cars, thousands of bolts, all held by the hub. One stroke severs every link—she can't mend it unless she goes all out.

t.zh: 诗人在空白的书上写了一个红色的字。
t.en: The poet writes one red word on the blank page.

text.zh: 葛兰坐在生锈的长椅上，旁边两瓶啤酒，一瓶开着，一瓶没开。
text.en: Gran sits on a rusted bench, two beers beside him, one open, one not.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 葛兰坐在生锈的长椅上，旁边两瓶啤酒，一瓶开着，一瓶没开。
t.en: Gran sits on a rusted bench, two beers beside him, one open, one not.

t.zh: 那小姑娘能把断的东西接回去。我砍一刀，她接一刀。
t.en: That girl joins whatever's cut. I cut, she joins.

t.zh: 那就砍她接不过来的东西。
t.en: Then cut something she can't join in time.

t.zh: 他不想要她的命。他想看那盏灯的底牌。
t.en: He doesn't want her life. He wants to see the lamp's last card.

text.zh: 来早了。还有十八分钟。喝吗？
text.en: You're early. Eighteen minutes. Beer?

label.zh: 抢先一步，挡在摩天轮的中心轴前面
label.en: Get there first and stand in front of the hub

text.zh: 我比他先到。我背靠着那根轴，把灯举在胸前。
text.en: I get there first. Back to the hub, lamp at my chest.

t.zh: 我比他先到。我背靠着那根轴，把灯举在胸前。
t.en: I get there first. Back to the hub, lamp at my chest.

t.zh: 你要砍它，就先砍我。可你不想要我的命，对吧？
t.en: If you cut it, you cut me first. And you don't want my life, do you?

t.zh: ……你知道我要砍什么。
t.en: …You knew what I'd cut.

t.zh: 哈。被看穿两次了，葛兰。
t.en: Ha. Seen through twice now, Gran.

t.zh: 剑尖停在我胸前三寸。他收了手。
t.en: The point stops three inches from my chest. He pulls back.

label.en: Hold, and wait for an opening

text.zh: 我一直接，一直退。他一直砍。然后他转过身，朝摩天轮冲过去。
text.en: I keep joining, keep backing away. He keeps cutting. Then he turns and charges the wheel.

t.zh: 我一直接，一直退。他一直砍。然后他转过身，朝摩天轮冲过去。
t.en: I keep joining, keep backing away. He keeps cutting. Then he turns and charges the wheel.

t.zh: 来早了。还有十八分钟。喝吗？
t.en: You're early. Eighteen minutes. Beer?

t.zh: 打完再说。
t.en: After.

t.zh: 也是。不管谁赢。
t.en: Fair. Whoever wins.

t.zh: 昨晚那句话，我想了一整天。今天还是要打。
t.en: I thought about what you said all day. We still fight.

t.zh: 在呢。
t.en: Here.

t.zh: 他动了。块头大，却快得像一辆没开灯的货车。断剑横扫，铁栏杆一节一节散开——不是被切断，是“连结”没了。
t.en: He moves. Big, but fast as an unlit truck. The Sword sweeps; the railings come apart—not cut, their connections simply gone.

t.zh: 我蹲下去，手按在地上。断开的栏杆往回长。
t.en: I crouch, palm to the ground. The severed railings grow back.

t.zh: 她接得比昨天还快。
t.en: She's joining faster than yesterday.

t.zh: 葛兰的目光越过我，落在我身后那座摩天轮上。
t.en: Gran's eyes go past me, to the Ferris wheel at my back.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

label.zh: “全部……修好！”——全力（会交出一段记忆）

text.zh: 灯火炸开，像一个太阳。四千六百个断口在光里一颗一颗地亮起来，又熄灭。下坠的车厢停在了半空。
text.en: The light bursts like a sun. Four thousand six hundred breaks light up one by one, then go dark. The falling cars stop in midair.

t.zh: 灯火炸开，像一个太阳。四千六百个断口在光里一颗一颗地亮起来，又熄灭。下坠的车厢停在了半空。
t.en: The light bursts like a sun. Four thousand six hundred breaks light up one by one, then go dark. The falling cars stop in midair.

t.zh: 那种被抽走的感觉，比昨天更重。台灯下拆开的闹钟。它重新走起来的时候，一只带着机油味的大手揉了揉我的头。“栖栖，你的手真巧。”
t.en: The feeling of being emptied, heavier than yesterday. An alarm clock in pieces under a desk lamp. When it ticks again, a big hand smelling of machine oil ruffles my hair. 'Qiqi, your hands are so clever.'

t.zh: 那天晚上是什么时候？父亲说了什么来着？
t.en: When was that night? What did Dad say?

t.zh: 第二段。第一次被父亲夸手巧的晚上。我收下了。
t.en: The second. The night your father first praised your hands. I'll keep it.

t.zh: 然后，摩天轮开始转了。没有电，它就那样自己慢慢地转了起来。
t.en: Then the wheel starts to turn. No power at all; it simply turns, slowly, on its own.

t.zh: 那一下的光，整个北岸都看见了。海湾对面的渔船上，有人举起了手机。
t.en: The whole north shore saw that flash. On a fishing boat across the bay, someone raised a phone.

label.zh: 只修中心轴——它是所有连结的根
label.en: Mend only the hub—it is the root of every link

text.zh: 我想起下午碰过的那根轴。所有的辐条、所有的车厢，都是从它那里伸出去的。
text.en: I remember the hub I touched this afternoon. Every spoke, every car, reaches out from there.

t.zh: 我想起下午碰过的那根轴。所有的辐条、所有的车厢，都是从它那里伸出去的。
t.en: I remember the hub I touched this afternoon. Every spoke, every car, reaches out from there.

t.zh: 不用修四千六百个。修一个就够了。
t.en: I don't need to mend four thousand six hundred. Just one.

t.zh: 白光只亮了一瞬，落在轴心上。轴想起了自己，辐条就想起了轴，车厢就想起了辐条。一个接一个，像一排倒回去的骨牌。
t.en: The light flashes once, onto the hub. The hub remembers itself; the spokes remember the hub; the cars remember the spokes. One by one, like dominoes falling backward.

t.zh: ……你没用全力。我什么都没拿。
t.en: …You didn't go all out. I took nothing.

t.zh: 摩天轮慢慢地转了起来。
t.en: The wheel begins, slowly, to turn.

label.zh: 扑进旁边的排水沟里躲开

text.zh: 我扑了出去。车厢砸下来的声音，像一整座城一起塌了。
text.en: I throw myself aside. The cars crash down like a whole city collapsing.

t.zh: 我扑了出去。车厢砸下来的声音，像一整座城一起塌了。
t.en: I throw myself aside. The cars crash down like a whole city collapsing.

t.zh: 等我爬起来，腰上的灯不见了。葛兰站在废墟上，手里提着它。
t.en: When I climb out, the lamp is gone from my belt. Gran stands on the wreckage, holding it.

t.zh: 断剑——
t.en: Sword—
—cut!

t.zh: 没有声音。那一刀从上往下划过空气，摩天轮上几千个连结同时松开了。
t.en: No sound. One stroke through the air, and thousands of links on the wheel let go at once.

t.zh: 四十八个车厢在半空中晃了一下，然后一起往下掉。几十吨的钢铁，朝我头顶砸下来。
t.en: Forty-eight cars sway in midair, then fall together. Tons of steel, straight at my head.

t.zh: 你修不过来。除非你全力出手。
t.en: You can't mend that in time. Not unless you go all out.

t.zh: 葛兰没有砍摩天轮。可他退开的时候，断剑擦过了底座——一根主辐条断了，整座轮子歪了一下。
t.en: Gran never cuts the wheel. But as he pulls back, the Sword grazes the base—a main spoke snaps and the whole wheel lurches.

t.zh: 只断了一根。你不用全力。
t.en: Only one. You don't need to go all out.

title.zh: 摩天轮下 · 打完以后

text.zh: 葛兰仰着头，看了那座转着的摩天轮很久。
text.en: Gran looks up at the turning wheel for a long time.

text.zh: 说好了，打完再喝。
text.en: Like we said. After.

t.zh: 说好了，打完再喝。
t.en: Like we said. After.

t.zh: 我们坐在长椅上，谁都没说话，看摩天轮转了一圈又一圈。
t.en: We sit on the bench, saying nothing, watching it go round and round.

t.zh: 下回打架，叫上我。
t.en: Next time there's a fight, call me.

label.en: 'You want the relics for the Sword, don't you?'

text.zh: ……你读过我的那一夜。
text.en: …You've read my night.

t.zh: ……你读过我的那一夜。
t.en: …You've read my night.

t.zh: 她陪了我十年。她想要的东西，只有王冠给得了。
t.en: She's been with me ten years. What she wants, only the Crown can give.

t.zh: 葛兰，别说了。
t.en: Gran, that's enough.

text.zh: 我走的时候，听见身后啤酒瓶盖被撬开的声音。
text.en: As I leave, I hear a bottle cap pop behind me.

t.zh: 我走的时候，听见身后啤酒瓶盖被撬开的声音。
t.en: As I leave, I hear a bottle cap pop behind me.

t.zh: 葛兰仰着头，看了那座转着的摩天轮很久。
t.en: Gran looks up at the turning wheel for a long time.

t.zh: ……她修好了。
t.en: …She mended it.

t.zh: 嗯。
t.en: Yeah.

t.zh: 我小时候来过这里。那时候它还亮着。
t.en: I came here as a kid. It still lit up then.

t.zh: 我看着它转，心里空了一块。我不知道那一块原来放着什么。
t.en: I watch it turn, and something in me is hollow. I don't know what used to be there.

text.zh: 我没有开大灯，只拧开了台灯。拉开抽屉，摸出一个硬皮笔记本。
text.en: I don't turn on the main light, only the desk lamp. From the drawer, a hardback notebook.

label.en: Close the notebook and open the door

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 我没有开大灯，只拧开了台灯。拉开抽屉，摸出一个硬皮笔记本。
t.en: I don't turn on the main light, only the desk lamp. From the drawer, a hardback notebook.

t.zh: 在提灯拿走更多东西之前，把她写下来。
t.en: Before the Lamp takes any more, I'll write her down.

t.zh: 我的母亲叫林遥。
t.en: My mother's name is Lin Yao.

t.zh: 她穿一件洗得发白的蓝外套，左边袖口有一块补丁，针脚歪歪扭扭。
t.en: She wears a washed-out blue coat with a crooked patch on the left cuff.

t.zh: 她做的番茄蛋汤很咸，每次都咸，可她自己从来不觉得。
t.en: Her tomato-and-egg soup is salty, every time, and she never notices.

t.zh: 她不会骑自行车。
t.en: She can't ride a bike.

t.zh: ……这句话是怎么冒出来的？如果她不会骑，那个下午扶着车座的人，就不是她。那是谁？
t.en: …Where did that come from? If she couldn't ride, then whoever held the seat that afternoon wasn't her. Then who?

t.zh: 这就是代价最可怕的地方。不是忘掉，是你再也分不清，剩下的哪些是真的。
t.en: That's the worst of the price. Not forgetting—never again being sure which of what's left is true.

t.zh: 我记得那个下午。扶车座的是……我还记得。所以我知道她不会骑。
t.en: I remember that afternoon. The one holding the seat was… I still remember. That's how I know she couldn't ride.

t.zh: 卷帘门外面，有人敲了三下。很有礼貌，间隔均匀，像是用尺子量过的。
t.en: Three knocks on the shutter. Polite, evenly spaced, as if measured with a ruler.

title.zh: 听潮茶楼三楼 · 下午三点（白秋）

text.zh: 白秋喜欢下午三点。不早不晚，正好够她听见想听的话。
text.en: Bai Qiu likes three in the afternoon. Not early, not late; just right for hearing what she wants to hear.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 白秋喜欢下午三点。不早不晚，正好够她听见想听的话。
t.en: Bai Qiu likes three in the afternoon. Not early, not late; just right for hearing what she wants to hear.

t.zh: 天平拿走的，是她做选择时的犹豫。所以五年来，她做什么决定都很快，快到自己都害怕。
t.en: What the Scales take is her hesitation. So for five years she has decided everything fast, so fast it frightens her.

t.zh: 我想要一个没有代价的世界。如果魔法不再拿走任何东西，就不会再有人那样死去了。
t.en: I want a world without a price. If magic stopped taking things, no one would die like that again.

t.zh: “这是个好愿望。”白衣的女孩说。“这是个坏愿望。”黑衣的女孩说。
t.en: 'That's a good wish,' says the girl in white. 'That's a bad wish,' says the girl in black.

title.en: The clock tower (the man with the umbrella)

text.zh: 撑黑伞的男人还站在栏杆边。棋盘上，白色的骑士往前走了一格。
text.en: The man with the black umbrella still stands at the rail. On the board, the white knight moves one square.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 撑黑伞的男人还站在栏杆边。棋盘上，白色的骑士往前走了一格。
t.en: The man with the black umbrella still stands at the rail. On the board, the white knight moves one square.

t.zh: “修灯的那个，”棋盘说，“第二次没有全力，也修好了。”
t.en: 'The lamp-mender,' says the chessboard, 'mended it the second time without going all out.'

t.zh: 男人没有说话。他看着那枚白骑士，看了很久。
t.en: The man says nothing. He looks at the white knight for a long time.

title.en: The clock tower (the man with the umbrella)

text.zh: 撑黑伞的男人还站在栏杆边。棋盘上，白色的骑士往前走了一格。
text.en: The man with the black umbrella still stands at the rail. On the board, the white knight moves one square.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 撑黑伞的男人还站在栏杆边。棋盘上，白色的骑士往前走了一格。
t.en: The man with the black umbrella still stands at the rail. On the board, the white knight moves one square.

t.zh: “修灯的那个，”棋盘说，“已经交出去两段了。”
t.en: 'The lamp-mender,' says the chessboard, 'has given up two already.'

t.zh: “六十年前，”男人说，“也是从第二段开始，她就不回头了。”
t.en: 'Sixty years ago,' the man says, 'it was after the second that she stopped looking back.'

text.zh: 深夜打扰。我是守秘局的监督官，奥古斯特·莱恩。今晚，我替您收拾了一座摩天轮。
text.en: Forgive the hour. I'm a supervisor with the Secrecy Bureau, August Lane. Tonight I tidied up a Ferris wheel for you.

label.zh: 签字，照实说摩天轮是我修的
label.en: Sign, and admit the wheel was mine

text.zh: 谢谢您的诚实。我明天会去申请一份“旧乐园改造项目试运营”的许可。
text.en: Thank you for your honesty. Tomorrow I'll file for an 'old park refurbishment trial run' permit.

t.zh: 谢谢您的诚实。我明天会去申请一份“旧乐园改造项目试运营”的许可。
t.en: Thank you for your honesty. Tomorrow I'll file for an 'old park refurbishment trial run' permit.

label.zh: 签字，然后把那张照片推到他面前
label.en: Sign, then slide the photo across to him

text.zh: 缺了门牙的小女孩举着手，身边是一片完整得过分的空白。
text.en: A gap-toothed girl reaching up, beside her a blank far too complete.

t.zh: 缺了门牙的小女孩举着手，身边是一片完整得过分的空白。
t.en: A gap-toothed girl reaching up, beside her a blank far too complete.

t.zh: 十一年前，她从所有人的记忆里消失了。只有我还记得。
t.en: Eleven years ago she vanished from everyone's memory. Only I remember.

t.zh: 十一年前？不是六十年前？……那就不对了。
t.en: Eleven years ago? Not sixty? …Then something's wrong.

t.zh: 或者说，上一次王冠改写的那条规则，到现在还在起作用。
t.en: Or else the rule the Crown rewrote last time is still working, even now.

label.zh: 签字，但说摩天轮不是我修的
label.en: Sign, but say the wheel wasn't you

text.zh: ……是吗。
text.en: …Is that so.

t.zh: ……是吗。
t.en: …Is that so.

t.zh: 他推了推老花镜，在表格的空白处写了一行很小的字。
t.en: He nudges his reading glasses and writes a tiny line in the margin.

t.zh: 深夜打扰。我是守秘局的监督官，奥古斯特·莱恩。今晚，我替您收拾了一座摩天轮。
t.en: Forgive the hour. I'm a supervisor with the Secrecy Bureau, August Lane. Tonight I tidied up a Ferris wheel for you.

t.zh: 守秘局在王冠之争里保持中立。我们只管一件事：普通人不应该知道魔法的存在。
t.en: The Bureau is neutral in the Crown war. We see to one thing only: ordinary people must not learn that magic exists.

t.zh: 他推过来一张表：第七次灰烬王冠之争·遗器持有者登记。十二行。最后一行，钥匙那一栏，什么都没有写——不是“空”，也不是“未登记”，就只是一片空白。
t.en: He slides a form across: Seventh Ashen Crown War · Relic Holder Register. Twelve lines. The last, for the Key, is empty—not 'none', not 'unregistered', just blank.

t.zh: 四百二十年来，钥匙那一栏从来没有填过。可是每一次王冠打开，都需要用到它。
t.en: In four hundred and twenty years, no one has ever filled in the Key. Yet every time the Crown opens, it is used.

t.zh: 请在这里签字。规则三条：不许在普通人面前使用遗器；不许伤害与王冠之争无关的人；王冠打开以后，结果由王冠决定。
t.en: Sign here. Three rules: no relics before ordinary people; no harm to anyone outside the war; once the Crown opens, the Crown decides.

text.zh: 回家的路上，坡底停着两辆没有标志的车。两个穿黑西装的人拦住我：“您好，市政燃气检测。这一带刚才有点异常。”
text.en: On the way home, two unmarked cars wait at the foot of the slope. Two men in black suits stop me. 'Good evening, city gas inspection. Something odd around here just now.'

label.zh: 站在路灯底下，问什么答什么
label.en: Stand under the streetlight and answer everything

text.zh: 问了二十分钟。走的时候，其中一个说：监督官晚点会去您铺子里。请说实话，省大家的事。
text.en: Twenty minutes of questions. Leaving, one says: the supervisor will call at your shop later. Please tell him the truth; it saves everyone trouble.

t.zh: 问了二十分钟。走的时候，其中一个说：监督官晚点会去您铺子里。请说实话，省大家的事。
t.en: Twenty minutes of questions. Leaving, one says: the supervisor will call at your shop later. Please tell him the truth; it saves everyone trouble.

text.zh: 他们没有追。可是那两辆车的灯，一直跟到了我铺子门口。
text.en: They don't follow on foot. But the cars' headlights follow me all the way to my shutter.

t.zh: 他们没有追。可是那两辆车的灯，一直跟到了我铺子门口。
t.en: They don't follow on foot. But the cars' headlights follow me all the way to my shutter.

t.zh: 回家的路上，坡底停着两辆没有标志的车。两个穿黑西装的人拦住我：“您好，市政燃气检测。这一带刚才有点异常。”
t.en: On the way home, two unmarked cars wait at the foot of the slope. Two men in black suits stop me. 'Good evening, city gas inspection. Something odd around here just now.'

t.zh: 他们不看燃气表。他们一直在看我腰上的灯。
t.en: They don't look at any meter. They keep looking at the lamp on my belt.

text.zh: 门缝里塞着一张纸条：你昨晚被人照了镜子。想知道是谁，下午三点，听潮茶楼三楼。署名是一架小小的天平。
text.en: A note under the door: Someone held a mirror to you last night. If you want to know who, 3 p.m., third floor of the Tidelistening Teahouse. Signed with a tiny pair of scales.

label.en: 'I'll mend it.'—lay a hand on the crack

text.zh: 裂纹很细，很深，从秤盘边缘一直延伸到中心。像是被什么太重的东西压裂的。
text.en: The crack is fine and deep, from rim to center. As if something far too heavy pressed it.

t.zh: 裂纹很细，很深，从秤盘边缘一直延伸到中心。像是被什么太重的东西压裂的。
t.en: The crack is fine and deep, from rim to center. As if something far too heavy pressed it.

t.zh: 我一点一点地，让它想起原来的样子。两只秤盘晃了晃，停在了同一个高度。平了。
t.en: Bit by bit I let it remember what it was. The pans sway and settle at the same height. Level.

t.zh: ……三年了。
t.en: …Three years.

label.zh: “你想要一个没有代价的世界，对吧？”
label.en: 'You want a world without a price, don't you?'

text.zh: ……你从哪里听来的？
text.en: …Where did you hear that?

t.zh: ……你从哪里听来的？
t.en: …Where did you hear that?

t.zh: 我修好它，但你得告诉我：压裂它的，是什么？
t.en: I'll mend it, but tell me: what cracked it?

t.zh: 那是第四条情报。……好吧。是一个人的命。总有一天告诉你。
t.en: That's a fourth piece. …Fine. A life. I'll tell you one day.

t.zh: 秤盘平了。
t.en: The pans come level.

label.en: 'I heard your information. I won't mend it.'

text.zh: 也好。你只要相信你自己的判断就好。
text.en: Fair enough. Trust your own judgment.

t.zh: 也好。你只要相信你自己的判断就好。
t.en: Fair enough. Trust your own judgment.

t.zh: 门缝里塞着一张纸条：你昨晚被人照了镜子。想知道是谁，下午三点，听潮茶楼三楼。署名是一架小小的天平。
t.en: A note under the door: Someone held a mirror to you last night. If you want to know who, 3 p.m., third floor of the Tidelistening Teahouse. Signed with a tiny pair of scales.

t.zh: 请坐，林小姐。茶刚泡好。
t.en: Have a seat, Miss Lin. The tea's just made.

t.zh: “喝茶吗？”白衣的说。“别喝茶。”黑衣的说。
t.en: 'Some tea?' says the one in white. 'Don't drink the tea,' says the one in black.

t.zh: 我手里有三条情报，都和你有关。换你修一样东西。
t.en: I have three pieces of information, all about you. In exchange, you mend one thing for me.

t.zh: 她把一架巴掌大的黄铜天平放在桌上。左边秤盘边缘有一道裂纹，一直裂到中心。
t.en: She sets a palm-sized brass scale on the table. A crack runs from the left pan's rim to the center.

t.zh: 第一条：昨晚你修摩天轮的时候，有人在灯塔上看着。第二条：伊芙琳的下一个目标，是卡罗·文斯的墨水瓶。
t.en: One: while you mended the wheel last night, someone watched from the lighthouse. Two: Evelyn's next target is Carlo Vince's Inkwell.

t.zh: 第三条：断剑的那道断口，是六十年前断的。断剑当时的主人，在钟楼上被一盏灯拦住了——你的那盏灯。提灯的上一任主人，亲手折断了断剑。
t.en: Three: the Sword broke sixty years ago. Its holder was stopped on the clock tower by a lamp—your lamp. The Lamp's last holder broke the Sword with her own hands.

t.zh: “是真的。”白衣的说。“是假的。”黑衣的说。两个声音完全重叠。
t.en: 'It's true,' says the one in white. 'It's false,' says the one in black. Their voices overlap exactly.

text.zh: 提灯。白秋说的是真的吗？六十年前，你的上一任主人折断了断剑？
text.en: Lamp. Was Bai Qiu telling the truth? Did your last holder break the Sword sixty years ago?

label.zh: 把灯挂回腰上，拉下卷帘门
label.en: Hang the lamp back on my belt and pull down the shutter

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 提灯。白秋说的是真的吗？六十年前，你的上一任主人折断了断剑？
t.en: Lamp. Was Bai Qiu telling the truth? Did your last holder break the Sword sixty years ago?

t.zh: ……我不记得了。王冠改写规则的时候，会把“改之前是什么样”从所有人的记忆里一起抹掉。连我们也一样。
t.en: …I don't remember. When the Crown rewrites a rule, it wipes what came before from everyone's memory. Us too.

t.zh: 灯座底下那两个字母，M. 和 S.，是谁？
t.en: The two letters under your base, M. and S.—who are they?

t.zh: ……不知道。可是每次你问，我这里就有一点疼。
t.en: …I don't know. But every time you ask, it hurts a little here.

t.zh: 钟楼敲了十二下。
t.en: The clock tower strikes twelve.

text.zh: 葛兰擦同一张桌子擦了三遍。断剑坐在吧台尽头她的老位置上，面前一杯朗姆，一口没动。
text.en: Gran wipes the same table three times. The Sword sits in her old seat at the end of the bar, a rum in front of her, untouched.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 葛兰擦同一张桌子擦了三遍。断剑坐在吧台尽头她的老位置上，面前一杯朗姆，一口没动。
t.en: Gran wipes the same table three times. The Sword sits in her old seat at the end of the bar, a rum in front of her, untouched.

t.zh: 说吧。昨晚你为什么放水。
t.en: Out with it. Why did you go easy last night?

t.zh: 葛兰，你知道遗器会不会死吗？我们会被打碎，会被埋在泥里，会被忘掉几百年。可我们不会死。
t.en: Gran, do you know if relics can die? We get smashed, buried in mud, forgotten for centuries. But we don't die.

t.zh: 我换过十一个主人。十一个人，每一个都在我身上交出了他们的恨。没有一个赢过。
t.en: I've had eleven holders. Eleven people, and each of them handed me their hatred. Not one of them ever won.

t.zh: 我想死。不是被打碎，不是睡过去。是真正地死。能改写世界规则的东西，只有王冠。
t.en: I want to die. Not smashed, not asleep. Really die. Only one thing can rewrite the world's rules: the Crown.

t.zh: 那你为什么不直接去求那个修灯的？
t.en: Then why not just ask the lamp-mender?

t.zh: 因为我更想让你赢。十一个主人，没有一个问过我想要什么。你是第一个给我倒酒的人。
t.en: Because I'd rather you won. Eleven holders, and not one asked what I wanted. You're the first who ever poured me a drink.

t.zh: 葛兰的喉咙一下子堵住了。
t.en: Something catches in Gran's throat.

title.zh: 老城区 · 霍克宅 20:15（葛兰）

text.zh: 十五年前，他就是从这扇门里被赶出去的。书桌后面的皮椅上，坐着一个瘦得像干柴的老人。只有那双眼睛没变。
text.en: Fifteen years ago he was thrown out through this door. In the leather chair behind the desk sits an old man, thin as kindling. Only the eyes haven't changed.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 十五年前，他就是从这扇门里被赶出去的。书桌后面的皮椅上，坐着一个瘦得像干柴的老人。只有那双眼睛没变。
t.en: Fifteen years ago he was thrown out through this door. In the leather chair behind the desk sits an old man, thin as kindling. Only the eyes haven't changed.

t.zh: 书架最上面一层，一个长条形的木匣子。盖子上刻着：霍克家第七代家主 · 阿尔伯特 · 断剑之主。
t.en: On the top shelf, a long wooden case. Carved on the lid: Albert, Seventh Head of the House of Hawke · Master of the Broken Sword.

t.zh: 匣子里铺着深红色的天鹅绒，绒面上有一道剑形的凹痕。凹痕里什么都没有。
t.en: Inside, dark-red velvet pressed with the shape of a sword. The hollow is empty.

t.zh: “他输了，回来以后什么都不记得。他坐在窗前二十年，每天从这个匣子里‘拿出’一把剑来擦。临死前，他抓着我的手说：告诉她，对不起。”
t.en: 'He lost, and came home remembering nothing. He sat at that window twenty years, taking a sword out of this case every morning to polish. Before he died he gripped my hand and said: tell her I'm sorry.'

t.zh: 我不是去跟他们打。我是去送一个朋友。一个喝了十年酒、从来没喝醉过的朋友。
t.en: I'm not going to fight them. I'm going to see a friend off. One who's been drinking for ten years and never once got drunk.

t.zh: 他走到门口。身后，父亲的声音很低：“三百一十七张。那天晚上，我数的是三百一十七张。那些符纸，我都留着。”
t.en: At the door, his father's voice, very low: 'Three hundred and seventeen. That night I counted three hundred and seventeen. I kept every one of them.'

t.zh: 葛兰没有回头。他怕自己一看，就再也走不动了。
t.en: Gran doesn't turn around. He's afraid that if he looks, he'll never be able to leave.

t.zh: 回到酒吧门口，一个报童模样的人递给他一个墨绿色的信封，蜡封上印着一架小小的天平：六十年前折断断剑的，是提灯的上一任主人。这一任提灯的主人，周五晚上会出现在旧港区的涂鸦街。
t.en: Back at the bar, someone dressed as a paperboy hands him a dark-green envelope, sealed with a tiny pair of scales: The Lamp's last holder broke the Sword sixty years ago. Its current holder will be on Mural Street in the old harbor on Friday night.

text.zh: 下午的铺子很安静。我把一台收音机的后盖拆下来，又装回去，什么都没修。
text.en: The shop is quiet in the afternoon. I take the back off a radio, put it on again, mend nothing.

label.zh: 去旧港区找卡罗，提醒他
label.en: Go to the old harbor and warn Carlo

text.zh: 涂鸦街的尽头，一个荧光绿头发的年轻人蹲在脚手架上，往一面三层楼高的砖墙上喷鲸鱼的轮廓。
text.en: At the end of Mural Street a young man with neon-green hair crouches on scaffolding, spraying the outline of a whale onto a three-story brick wall.

t.zh: 涂鸦街的尽头，一个荧光绿头发的年轻人蹲在脚手架上，往一面三层楼高的砖墙上喷鲸鱼的轮廓。
t.en: At the end of Mural Street a young man with neon-green hair crouches on scaffolding, spraying the outline of a whale onto a three-story brick wall.

t.zh: 伊芙琳·冯·艾希周五会来拿你的墨水瓶。
t.en: Evelyn von Eiche is coming for your Inkwell on Friday.

t.zh: 让她来。周五我要让这条鲸鱼游出来，让整条街的人都看见。魔法师们藏了几百年，凭什么？
t.en: Let her. On Friday this whale swims off the wall and the whole street sees it. Wizards have hidden for centuries. Why should they?

t.zh: 他身边，一个戴眼镜的书记员从墨水瓶里探出半个身子，推了推眼镜。
t.en: Beside him, a bespectacled clerk leans halfway out of an inkwell and pushes up his glasses.

t.zh: 写下来的东西会暂时成真。不过，得先写。
t.en: What is written comes true for a while. But it has to be written first.

t.zh: 先写。写要时间，要手，要看得见写在哪里。
t.en: Written first. Writing takes time, a hand, and somewhere to see it land.

t.zh: 那就别等她开口。先把字写好。
t.en: Then don't wait for her to speak. Have your words ready.

t.zh: ……你这人真奇怪。周五来看吧，修灯的。
t.en: …You're a strange one. Come and watch on Friday, lamp-mender.

label.zh: 留在铺子里，把身体和灯都养好
label.en: Stay in the shop; let both body and lamp recover

text.zh: 我把灯放在柜台上，用软布擦了一下午。灯芯的火苗慢慢站直了。
text.en: I set the lamp on the counter and polish it all afternoon. The flame on the wick slowly straightens.

t.zh: 我把灯放在柜台上，用软布擦了一下午。灯芯的火苗慢慢站直了。
t.en: I set the lamp on the counter and polish it all afternoon. The flame on the wick slowly straightens.

t.zh: ……谢谢。很舒服。
t.en: …Thanks. That's nice.

t.zh: 下午的铺子很安静。我把一台收音机的后盖拆下来，又装回去，什么都没修。
t.en: The shop is quiet in the afternoon. I take the back off a radio, put it on again, mend nothing.

t.zh: 你在想白秋说的事。伊芙琳的下一个目标，是卡罗·文斯的墨水瓶。
t.en: You're thinking about what Bai Qiu said. Evelyn's next target is Carlo Vince's Inkwell.

t.zh: 周五晚上。还有三天。
t.en: Friday night. Three days.

t.zh: 那不是你的仗。
t.en: That isn't your fight.

t.zh: 如果她拿到第二件，就会去拿第三件。迟早轮到我。
t.en: If she gets a second, she'll go for a third. Sooner or later it's me.

text.zh: 周五。我把风衣穿上，把灯挂在腰上。
text.en: Friday. I put on my coat and hang the lamp from my belt.

label.zh: 早点出门，十点半之前到涂鸦街
label.en: Leave early; reach Mural Street before ten thirty

text.zh: 我抄近路下了坡。港口的风里有油漆味。
text.en: I take the shortcut down the slope. The harbor wind smells of paint.

t.zh: 我抄近路下了坡。港口的风里有油漆味。
t.en: I take the shortcut down the slope. The harbor wind smells of paint.

label.en: Wait until the lamp is a little brighter

text.zh: 等我出门，已经快十一点了。
text.en: By the time I leave it's nearly eleven.

t.zh: 等我出门，已经快十一点了。
t.en: By the time I leave it's nearly eleven.

t.zh: 周五。我把风衣穿上，把灯挂在腰上。
t.en: Friday. I put on my coat and hang the lamp from my belt.

t.zh: 手机上有一条短信，号码不认识：今晚十点半，最大的那条。——卡罗
t.en: A text from a number I don't know: Ten thirty tonight. The biggest one. —Carlo

t.zh: 林栖。如果今晚你要全力出手，告诉我一声。我好挑。
t.en: Lin. If you go all out tonight, warn me. So I can choose.

t.zh: 挑什么？
t.en: Choose what?

t.zh: 挑一段你最不会想念的。……虽然没有这种东西。
t.en: One you'd miss least. …Though there's no such thing.

text.zh: 卡罗·文斯画过整座维斯特林。每一幅画，第二天早上都会被市政的人刷掉。他被抓过十一次，罚过三十多次款。
text.en: Carlo Vince has painted all of Westerling. Every piece is scrubbed off by the city by morning. Arrested eleven times, fined more than thirty.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 卡罗·文斯画过整座维斯特林。每一幅画，第二天早上都会被市政的人刷掉。他被抓过十一次，罚过三十多次款。
t.en: Carlo Vince has painted all of Westerling. Every piece is scrubbed off by the city by morning. Arrested eleven times, fined more than thirty.

t.zh: 只有一个小女孩看过他的鲸鱼以后，问他：叔叔，它会游走吗？那天晚上，他在旧货市场买到了一个墨水瓶。
t.en: Only one little girl ever looked at his whale and asked: will it swim away? That night he bought an inkwell at a flea market.

t.zh: 写什么？
t.en: What shall I write?

t.zh: 老样子。让它游。
t.en: Same as always. Let it swim.

t.zh: 鲸鱼眨了一下眼睛，从墙上游了出来。肚子上的星星一颗一颗地亮起来，把整条街照成了深蓝色的海底。窗户里，有人探出了头。
t.en: The whale blinks and swims out of the wall. The stars on its belly light one by one, turning the street into a deep-blue seabed. Heads lean out of windows.

t.zh: 他们只是没有机会知道，世界可以比他们以为的更大。
t.en: They've just never had the chance to learn the world could be bigger than they thought.

text.zh: 伊芙琳·冯·艾希对打架没有兴趣。她对“赢”有兴趣。打架只是赢的一种方式，而且是最笨的一种。
text.en: Evelyn von Eiche has no interest in fighting. She is interested in winning. Fighting is just one way to win, and the stupidest.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 伊芙琳·冯·艾希对打架没有兴趣。她对“赢”有兴趣。打架只是赢的一种方式，而且是最笨的一种。
t.en: Evelyn von Eiche has no interest in fighting. She is interested in winning. Fighting is just one way to win, and the stupidest.

t.zh: 我的小姐，您还没告诉我，您为什么想赢。
t.en: My lady, you still haven't told me why you want to win.

t.zh: 赢了以后再想。
t.en: I'll think about it after I win.

t.zh: 荆棘冠每次替您开口，都会收下一点东西。关于您自己的骄傲。
t.en: Every time the Crown speaks for you, it keeps something. A little of your pride in yourself.

t.zh: 那就收。我本来也不需要那个。
t.en: Let it. I never needed that anyway.

t.zh: 诗人深深地鞠了一躬，嘴角微微翘了起来。
t.en: The poet bows deeply; the corner of his mouth lifts.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

label.zh: 冲卡罗喊：“现在就写！别等她开口！”
label.en: Shout to Carlo: 'Write it now! Don't wait for her to speak!'

text.zh: 卡罗！先写！
text.en: Carlo! Write first!

t.zh: 卡罗！先写！
t.en: Carlo! Write first!

t.zh: 羽毛笔在空中飞快地写了一行红字：荆棘烧尽。
t.en: The quill races through the air in red: Thorns, burn.

t.zh: 红色的字迹变成了火，顺着荆棘一路烧过去。伊芙琳往后退了一步，大衣的下摆着了火。
t.en: The red letters become fire, running along the thorns. Evelyn steps back; the hem of her coat catches.

t.zh: ……你看出来了。写比说慢。所以要先写。
t.en: …You saw it. Writing is slower than speech. So you write first.

t.zh: 那就让他写不出来。卡罗，你的手。
t.en: Then he won't write at all. Carlo, your hands.

t.zh: 两个字，变成两根荆棘，在下一行字落下之前缠住了他的手腕。羽毛笔掉在地上。
t.en: Two words, two thorns, around his wrists before the next line can fall. The quill drops.

t.zh: 可她没有再封他的眼睛和嘴。她弯腰捡起墨水瓶的时候，看了我一眼。
t.en: But she doesn't bind his eyes or mouth. Bending to pick up the Inkwell, she glances at me.

label.zh: 看着。记住她每一句话变成什么
label.en: Watch. Remember what each of her words becomes

text.zh: “你的手。你的眼睛。你的嘴。”三句话，三根荆棘。说比写快，快很多。
text.en: 'Your hands. Your eyes. Your mouth.' Three sentences, three thorns. Speech is faster than writing. Much faster.

t.zh: “你的手。你的眼睛。你的嘴。”三句话，三根荆棘。说比写快，快很多。
t.en: 'Your hands. Your eyes. Your mouth.' Three sentences, three thorns. Speech is faster than writing. Much faster.

t.zh: 她每一次都先说要缠住什么。她得说出来。
t.en: Every time, she names what to bind first. She has to say it.

text.zh: 他输了。
text.en: He lost.

t.zh: 他输了。
t.en: He lost.

t.zh: 所以你不需要再绑着他。
t.en: So you don't need to keep him bound.

t.zh: 她看了我一眼，像是有点意外。然后抬了抬手指，荆棘一根一根枯萎，化成了黑色的灰。
t.en: She looks at me as if mildly surprised. Then she lifts a finger, and the thorns wither one by one into black ash.

t.zh: 我赶到的时候，鲸鱼还在半空中游。街口站着一个穿红大衣的女人。
t.en: When I arrive the whale is still swimming in midair. A woman in a red coat stands at the mouth of the street.

t.zh: 卡罗·文斯。你在普通人面前使用遗器。守秘局那个老古董太慢了，我替他收。
t.en: Carlo Vince. You used a relic in front of ordinary people. The Bureau's old relic is too slow; I'll collect for him.

t.zh: 鲸鱼，落下来。
t.en: Whale. Fall.

t.zh: 她说出的每一个字，都在半空中变成了一根带刺的藤。蓝色的颜料像血一样往下淌。
t.en: Every word she speaks becomes a thorned vine in the air. Blue paint drips like blood.

t.zh: 我赶到的时候，一切都结束了。满地都是蓝色的油漆，像一条被打碎的河。卡罗跪在中间，手腕、眼睛和嘴上缠着黑色的荆棘。
t.en: When I arrive it's all over. Blue paint everywhere, like a shattered river. Carlo kneels in the middle, black thorns around his wrists, his eyes, his mouth.

t.zh: 修灯的。你来晚了。不过也没关系，你来早了也拦不住我。
t.en: Lamp-mender. You're late. Not that it matters; you couldn't have stopped me early either.

text.zh: 我扶住卡罗，用指尖碰了碰他手腕上的伤口。伤口在指尖下慢慢合拢了。伊芙琳把深蓝色的墨水瓶举在路灯下看。
text.en: I hold Carlo up and touch the cut on his wrist. It closes under my fingertip. Evelyn holds the dark-blue Inkwell up to the streetlight.

text.zh: 你赢了，会改写一条规则。会影响所有人，包括他，包括那些刚刚关上窗户的人。我想知道你要改什么。
text.en: If you win you'll rewrite a rule. It touches everyone—him, the people who just shut their windows. I want to know what you'll change.

t.zh: 你赢了，会改写一条规则。会影响所有人，包括他，包括那些刚刚关上窗户的人。我想知道你要改什么。
t.en: If you win you'll rewrite a rule. It touches everyone—him, the people who just shut their windows. I want to know what you'll change.

t.zh: ……我还没想好。
t.en: …I haven't decided.

t.zh: 没想好就去打仗？
t.en: You go to war without deciding?

t.zh: 没想好，也可以先赢。
t.en: You can win first and decide after.

t.zh: “赢了以后再想。”她对诗人也是这么说的。一字不差。
t.en: 'I'll think about it after I win.' Word for word what she told the poet.

label.zh: 什么都不说，只是看着她的手
label.en: Say nothing; just watch her hands

text.zh: 她握墨水瓶的手，在手套里轻轻蜷了一下。像是有什么东西被抽走了，很轻，很快。
text.en: The hand holding the Inkwell curls slightly inside its glove. As if something were drawn out of her, light and quick.

t.zh: 她握墨水瓶的手，在手套里轻轻蜷了一下。像是有什么东西被抽走了，很轻，很快。
t.en: The hand holding the Inkwell curls slightly inside its glove. As if something were drawn out of her, light and quick.

t.zh: 我扶住卡罗，用指尖碰了碰他手腕上的伤口。伤口在指尖下慢慢合拢了。伊芙琳把深蓝色的墨水瓶举在路灯下看。
t.en: I hold Carlo up and touch the cut on his wrist. It closes under my fingertip. Evelyn holds the dark-blue Inkwell up to the streetlight.

t.zh: 你很喜欢修东西。那就别做别的。回家去，修你的收音机。这场仗不适合你。
t.en: You like mending things. So don't do anything else. Go home and fix your radios. This war isn't for you.

text.zh: 修灯的，你后面有人。
text.en: Lamp-mender. Someone's behind you.

label.zh: 他要砍的不是我——两只手握住我和提灯之间的那根线
label.en: It isn't me he'll cut—grip the line between me and the Lamp with both hands

text.zh: 摩天轮底下，他砍的是连结。今晚也一样。他要先断我的灯。
text.en: Under the wheel, he cut links. Tonight is no different. He'll sever my lamp first.

t.zh: 摩天轮底下，他砍的是连结。今晚也一样。他要先断我的灯。
t.en: Under the wheel, he cut links. Tonight is no different. He'll sever my lamp first.

t.zh: 我没有摘灯。我闭上眼，用修复术去“握”住胸口那根看不见的弦。
t.en: I don't unhook the lamp. I close my eyes and use the mending to hold the invisible string in my chest.

t.zh: 断剑落下来，砍在弦上。弦嗡的一声，弯了——没有断。我一直在修它，他砍一寸，我接一寸。
t.en: The Sword comes down on the string. It thrums and bends—and holds. I keep mending it; for every inch he cuts, I join one.

t.zh: ……葛兰。她第三次看穿你了。
t.en: …Gran. That's the third time she's read you.

t.zh: 你为什么不用全力？
t.en: Why won't you go all out?

t.zh: 我怕忘了她。我妈妈。
t.en: I'm afraid of forgetting her. My mum.

t.zh: 葛兰的手指在剑柄上收紧了。远处，警笛声越来越近。
t.en: Gran's fingers tighten on the hilt. In the distance, sirens getting closer.

t.zh: 下一次，你要是还不用全力，我就真的砍你了。
t.en: Next time, if you still won't go all out, I really will cut you.

text.zh: 灯火炸开。断剑砍在白光里，像砍进了一面墙。葛兰被光推出去七八米，靠在一面画满鲸鱼的墙上。
text.en: The light bursts. The Sword strikes into the white like striking a wall. Gran is shoved back seven or eight meters against a wall of painted whales.

t.zh: 灯火炸开。断剑砍在白光里，像砍进了一面墙。葛兰被光推出去七八米，靠在一面画满鲸鱼的墙上。
t.en: The light bursts. The Sword strikes into the white like striking a wall. Gran is shoved back seven or eight meters against a wall of painted whales.

t.zh: 那种被抽走的感觉来了。五岁，梧桐树底下，一只八音盒。妈妈叫我吃饭，我说它现在就坏着，它现在就难受。
t.en: The emptying comes. Five years old, under the plane tree, a music box. Mum calls me in to eat; I say it's broken right now, it hurts right now.

t.zh: 第三段。你第一次修好的八音盒。我收下了。
t.en: The third. The first music box you ever mended. I'll keep it.

t.zh: 整条涂鸦街都被照亮了。街两边的窗户里，有人尖叫。
t.en: The whole of Mural Street lights up. In the windows on either side, someone screams.

t.zh: ……这才像样。
t.en: …That's more like it.

t.zh: 葛兰，走吧。守秘局的人马上就到。
t.en: Gran, let's go. The Bureau's almost here.

text.zh: 就这一瞬间的犹豫，葛兰已经到了面前。断剑没有砍我，它砍的是我和提灯之间的那根线。腰上的灯一下子变得冰凉。
text.en: In that one moment of hesitation Gran is on me. The Sword doesn't cut me; it cuts the line between me and the Lamp. The lamp at my belt goes cold.

t.zh: 就这一瞬间的犹豫，葛兰已经到了面前。断剑没有砍我，它砍的是我和提灯之间的那根线。腰上的灯一下子变得冰凉。
t.en: In that one moment of hesitation Gran is on me. The Sword doesn't cut me; it cuts the line between me and the Lamp. The lamp at my belt goes cold.

t.zh: 接上！
t.en: Rejoin it!

t.zh: 我抓了两次，都没有抓住。缠着绷带的拳头，正正地砸在我的腹部。我撞在墙上，又摔进了满地的蓝色油漆里。
t.en: I grab twice and miss both times. A bandaged fist lands square in my stomach. I hit the wall and slide down into the blue paint.

t.zh: 葛兰，够了。她不想打。你看不出来吗？她怕再交出去什么。
t.en: Gran, enough. She doesn't want to fight. Can't you see? She's afraid of giving up anything else.

t.zh: 你为什么不用全力？
t.en: Why won't you go all out?

t.zh: ……我怕忘了她。我妈妈。
t.en: …I'm afraid of forgetting her. My mum.

t.zh: 下一次，你要是还不用全力，我就真的砍你了。
t.en: Next time, if you still won't go all out, I really will cut you.

t.zh: 他走了。夜空被两边的楼夹成一条细缝，缝里有一颗很淡的星星。腰上的灯没有温度。我闭上了眼睛。
t.en: He leaves. The sky is a thin slit between the buildings, with one faint star in it. The lamp at my belt has no warmth. I close my eyes.

label.zh: 不理他，转身去追伊芙琳的墨水瓶
label.en: Ignore him and turn to chase Evelyn and the Inkwell

text.zh: 我背对着他跑出去三步。第四步的时候，胸口那根弦断了，断得干干净净。
text.en: I run three steps with my back to him. On the fourth, the string in my chest snaps, cleanly.

t.zh: 我背对着他跑出去三步。第四步的时候，胸口那根弦断了，断得干干净净。
t.en: I run three steps with my back to him. On the fourth, the string in my chest snaps, cleanly.

t.zh: 这一次，没有人喊“接上”。
t.en: This time no one shouts 'Rejoin it'.

t.zh: 修灯的，你后面有人。
t.en: Lamp-mender. Someone's behind you.

t.zh: 涂鸦街的另一头，站着葛兰。拳头上缠着白色的绷带，手里拎着半截发着冷光的断剑。他的脸上什么表情都没有，像一块石头。
t.en: At the other end of the street stands Gran. White bandages on his fists, the half-sword glowing cold in his hand. His face shows nothing at all, like stone.

t.zh: 六十年前，是你那盏灯的上一任主人，折断了断剑。
t.en: Sixty years ago, your lamp's last holder broke the Sword.

t.zh: 墨绿色的信，天平的蜡封。白秋也给他送了一份。
t.en: A dark-green letter with a scales seal. Bai Qiu sent him one too.

t.zh: 我不在乎六十年前发生了什么。我只在乎一件事：我要赢。
t.en: I don't care what happened sixty years ago. I care about one thing: winning.

t.zh: 他冲了过来。我伸手去摘腰上的灯——手停住了。如果我再全力出手一次，提灯会拿走什么？
t.en: He charges. I reach for the lamp at my belt—and my hand stops. If I go all out again, what will the Lamp take?

t.zh: “我想让我的最后一个主人，是给我倒酒的那个。”他是在替她打。
t.en: 'I want my last holder to be the one who poured me a drink.' He's fighting for her.

text.zh: 守秘局的车开进了街口。一个西装扣子扣到最上面一颗的老人走过来，看了看满地的蓝色，又看了看我。
text.en: Bureau cars pull into the street. An old man with his jacket buttoned to the top walks over, looks at the blue everywhere, then at me.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 守秘局的车开进了街口。一个西装扣子扣到最上面一颗的老人走过来，看了看满地的蓝色，又看了看我。
t.en: Bureau cars pull into the street. An old man with his jacket buttoned to the top walks over, looks at the blue everywhere, then at me.

t.zh: 林小姐。整条街的人都看见了。我需要一个晚上，和很多燃气公司的通知单。
t.en: Miss Lin. The whole street saw that. I'll need a night and a great many gas-company notices.

t.zh: 别说话。我送您去医院。那里有一位医生，不问问题。
t.en: Don't talk. I'll take you to hospital. There's a doctor there who doesn't ask questions.

t.zh: 您没受伤？……那请帮我扶一下文斯先生。他得去医院。
t.en: You're not hurt? …Then please help me with Mr. Vince. He needs a hospital.

title.zh: 中心医院急诊科 · 凌晨 00:40（苏蔓）

text.zh: 苏蔓这周上了六个夜班。消毒水的味道浓得能把鼻子腌透，她早就闻不出来了。
text.en: Su Man has worked six night shifts this week. The disinfectant could pickle a nose; she stopped smelling it long ago.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 苏蔓这周上了六个夜班。消毒水的味道浓得能把鼻子腌透，她早就闻不出来了。
t.en: Su Man has worked six night shifts this week. The disinfectant could pickle a nose; she stopped smelling it long ago.

t.zh: 守秘局送来一个短头发的年轻女人，满身蓝色油漆，手里死死攥着一盏黄铜提灯，护士怎么掰都掰不开。
t.en: The Bureau brings in a short-haired young woman covered in blue paint, a brass lamp clenched in her hand so tight the nurses can't pry it loose.

t.zh: 三个月前，苏蔓在医院地下室捡到了一只木头摇篮。从那以后，一个戴面纱的女人跟着她，一言不发。
t.en: Three months ago Su Man found a wooden cradle in the hospital basement. Since then a veiled woman has followed her, silent.

t.zh: 让她睡吧。她太累了。她已经失去了太多。只要你愿意，我可以让她一直睡下去，直到所有人都忘了她。
t.en: Let her sleep. She's so tired. She has lost too much already. If you wish it, I can let her sleep until everyone forgets her.

t.zh: 不。我是医生。我的病人，要醒过来。痛不痛，要不要继续打，是她醒过来以后自己决定的。
t.en: No. I'm a doctor. My patient wakes up. Whether it hurts, whether she keeps fighting—that's hers to decide when she's awake.

t.zh: 她看着那盏灯。“小时候，我外婆家的阁楼上，挂过一盏一模一样的。”
t.en: She looks at the lamp. 'When I was little, there was one exactly like it hanging in my grandmother's attic.'

title.zh: 〇号线废弃隧道 · 21:00（雷恩兄弟）

text.zh: 雷恩兄弟出生的时候只隔了四分钟。十八岁那年他们黑进了银行，被抓了。哥哥亚当替弟弟扛下所有罪名，坐了三年牢。
text.en: The Rhine brothers were born four minutes apart. At eighteen they hacked a bank and were caught. Adam, the elder, took the whole blame and served three years.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 雷恩兄弟出生的时候只隔了四分钟。十八岁那年他们黑进了银行，被抓了。哥哥亚当替弟弟扛下所有罪名，坐了三年牢。
t.en: The Rhine brothers were born four minutes apart. At eighteen they hacked a bank and were caught. Adam, the elder, took the whole blame and served three years.

t.zh: 出狱那天以后，亚当再没摘下过那副耳机，本再没摘下过那个口罩。
t.en: Since the day he got out, Adam has never taken off his headphones, and Ben has never taken off his mask.

t.zh: 镜子照过她的修复术。修复的反面，就是拆解。只是威力只有原版的一半。
t.en: The mirror caught her mending. The flip side of mending is unmaking. At half the strength of the original.

t.zh: 哥，我们为什么要打她？她手里只有一件。
t.en: Why her, though? She's only got one.

t.zh: 因为打伊芙琳会死。打她，不会。
t.en: Because fighting Evelyn gets us killed. Fighting her won't.

t.zh: 本摸了摸脖子上的铜怀表。钟拿走的，是时间的顺序。他有时候分不清，哥哥是先坐牢，还是先出狱。
t.en: Ben touches the brass pocket watch at his throat. The Clock takes the order of time. Some days he can't tell whether his brother went to prison first or came out first.

t.zh: 他想要的那条规则，从来没告诉过亚当：他想让自己，可以不再是亚当的弟弟。
t.en: The rule he wants, he has never told Adam: to no longer have to be Adam's little brother.

title.zh: 北区 · 老公寓屋顶 23:40（伊芙琳）

text.zh: 战斗只持续了两分钟。“风筝的线，断。”一根细得像丝的荆棘，缠住了器灵和主人之间那根看不见的线。
text.en: The fight lasts two minutes. 'Kite string. Break.' A thorn fine as silk catches the invisible line between spirit and holder.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 战斗只持续了两分钟。“风筝的线，断。”一根细得像丝的荆棘，缠住了器灵和主人之间那根看不见的线。
t.en: The fight lasts two minutes. 'Kite string. Break.' A thorn fine as silk catches the invisible line between spirit and holder.

t.zh: 你要飞吗？
t.en: Do you want to fly?

t.zh: 不。我要赢。
t.en: No. I want to win.

t.zh: 少女握住了她戴着手套的手指。那种被抽走的感觉又来了，比刚才重一点。
t.en: The girl takes her gloved fingers. The emptying comes again, heavier than before.

t.zh: 诗人。我刚才……是不是忘了什么？
t.en: Poet. Did I just… forget something?

t.zh: 她记得十八岁那年的考核，一百年来的最高分，所有考官都站起来看着她。可那种站在考场门口、胸口发烫的感觉——没有了。
t.en: She remembers the exam at eighteen, the highest score in a century, every examiner on his feet. But that burning feeling at the door of the hall—gone.

t.zh: 她手里握着三件遗器。她是这场仗里第一个手握三件的人。可她一点都不觉得骄傲。
t.en: She holds three relics. The first in this war to hold three. And she feels no pride at all.

text.zh: 我叫苏蔓，急诊科的医生。你的灯在睡觉。它自己在修。
text.en: I'm Su Man, an emergency doctor. Your lamp is asleep. It's mending itself.

label.zh: “她叫林遥。十一年前，她消失了。只有我还记得。”
label.en: 'Her name is Lin Yao. She vanished eleven years ago. Only I remember.'

text.zh: 你昏迷的时候一直在叫妈妈。可你的病历上，母亲那一栏写的是“信息缺失”。
text.en: You kept calling for your mum while you were out. But on your chart, the mother field says 'information missing'.

t.zh: 你昏迷的时候一直在叫妈妈。可你的病历上，母亲那一栏写的是“信息缺失”。
t.en: You kept calling for your mum while you were out. But on your chart, the mother field says 'information missing'.

t.zh: 我外婆阁楼上有一盏和你这个一模一样的灯。她擦了四十年，却说不出那是谁的。
t.en: My grandmother's attic had a lamp just like yours. She polished it for forty years and could never say whose it was.

t.zh: 我的电话。下次你再被人打成这样，直接打给我，别等守秘局。他们太慢了。
t.en: My number. Next time someone does this to you, call me directly. The Bureau is too slow.

label.zh: “谢谢你治我。别的，我还不能说。”
label.en: 'Thank you for treating me. The rest I can't say yet.'

text.zh: 随你。你需要休息至少两周。但我猜你不会听我的。
text.en: Suit yourself. You need two weeks' rest at least. But I doubt you'll listen.

t.zh: 随你。你需要休息至少两周。但我猜你不会听我的。
t.en: Suit yourself. You need two weeks' rest at least. But I doubt you'll listen.

t.zh: 我是被疼醒的。肚子，肋骨，头，手——手指僵得像木头，因为攥了一整夜的灯。
t.en: Pain wakes me. Stomach, ribs, head, hands—my fingers stiff as wood from clutching the lamp all night.

t.zh: 我在走廊的长椅上坐了一夜。卡罗在里面缝针。天亮的时候，一个穿白大褂的女人在我旁边坐下了。
t.en: I sit all night on a bench in the corridor while Carlo gets stitched. At dawn a woman in a white coat sits down beside me.

t.zh: 我叫苏蔓，急诊科的医生。你的灯在睡觉。它自己在修。
t.en: I'm Su Man, an emergency doctor. Your lamp is asleep. It's mending itself.

t.zh: 你怎么知道？
t.en: How do you know?

t.zh: 她往旁边让了让。在她身后，站着一个戴面纱的女人。
t.en: She shifts aside. Behind her stands a veiled woman.

t.zh: 我不想赢，也不想改写任何规则。我想阻止王冠被打开。六十年前有人改了一条规则，从那以后，每隔几年就会有人从世界上消失。不是死，是消失。
t.en: I don't want to win or rewrite anything. I want to stop the Crown opening. Someone changed a rule sixty years ago, and since then, every few years, someone vanishes from the world. Not dies. Vanishes.

text.zh: 对了。你出院以后，最好别坐地铁。昨晚有人入侵了地铁的调度系统，是一对双胞胎干的。
text.en: One more thing. After you leave, don't take the metro. Someone broke into the metro dispatch last night. A pair of twins.

label.zh: 手按在葛兰背上——修好被拉长的时间
label.en: Hand on Gran's back—mend the stretched time

text.zh: 镜子复制的修复术，是我修摩天轮的那一次。我修过东西，从来没有修过时间。镜子也没照过。
text.en: The mending the mirror copied was the wheel. I've mended things, never time. The mirror has never seen that.

t.zh: 镜子复制的修复术，是我修摩天轮的那一次。我修过东西，从来没有修过时间。镜子也没照过。
t.en: The mending the mirror copied was the wheel. I've mended things, never time. The mirror has never seen that.

t.zh: 被拉长的时间像一根拉坏的弹簧。每一个点都想弹回去，都想起它原本的长度。
t.en: Stretched time is like an overstretched spring. Every point wants to snap back, remembers its true length.

t.zh: 接上。
t.en: Rejoin.

t.zh: 时间弹了回去。葛兰的手臂一轻，断剑像一道闪电劈了出去。
t.en: Time springs back. Gran's arm goes light; the Sword flies out like lightning.

t.zh: 原版和复制品撞在一起。复制品碎了。亚当被震得撞在墙上，镜子从手里脱出去，在地上滑出好远。
t.en: Original meets copy. The copy shatters. Adam slams into the wall; the mirror skids away across the ground.

t.zh: ……你没用全力。你修好了一样它没见过的东西。
t.en: …You didn't go all out. You mended something it had never seen.

label.zh: 全力，把镜子里的光整个修回去（会交出一段记忆）
label.en: All out—mend every copied light back into the mirror (costs a memory)

text.zh: 灯火从我的掌心里涌出来，把整条隧道照成了白天。镜子里所有的光，被一道一道地按了回去。
text.en: Light floods out of my palm and turns the tunnel to day. Every light in the mirror is pressed back in, one after another.

t.zh: 灯火从我的掌心里涌出来，把整条隧道照成了白天。镜子里所有的光，被一道一道地按了回去。
t.en: Light floods out of my palm and turns the tunnel to day. Every light in the mirror is pressed back in, one after another.

t.zh: 那种被抽走的感觉。很咸的番茄蛋汤，每次都咸，她自己从来不觉得。是什么味道来着？
t.en: The emptying. Too-salty tomato-and-egg soup, salty every time, and she never noticed. What did it taste like?

t.zh: 第四段。那碗很咸的汤。我收下了。
t.en: The fourth. That too-salty soup. I'll keep it.

t.zh: 葛兰的刃劈出去，复制品碎了。镜子从亚当手里飞出去，在地上滑出好远。
t.en: Gran's blade lands; the copy shatters. The mirror flies from Adam's hand and skids across the ground.

label.zh: 趁葛兰拖住他们，从另一头跑出去
label.en: While Gran holds them, run out the other end

text.zh: 我跑进了黑暗里。身后，冷白色的刃落下来——是镜子里的那一刀。
text.en: I run into the dark. Behind me the cold white blade falls—the copy from the mirror.

t.zh: 我跑进了黑暗里。身后，冷白色的刃落下来——是镜子里的那一刀。
t.en: I run into the dark. Behind me the cold white blade falls—the copy from the mirror.

t.zh: 这一次，没有人站在我前面。
t.en: This time no one stands in front of me.

t.zh: 对了。你出院以后，最好别坐地铁。昨晚有人入侵了地铁的调度系统，是一对双胞胎干的。
t.en: One more thing. After you leave, don't take the metro. Someone broke into the metro dispatch last night. A pair of twins.

t.zh: 列车在隧道里突然停下了。窗外的墙太旧了，水泥上长满青苔，墙上是褪色的标识：〇号线。
t.en: The train stops dead in the tunnel. The walls outside are too old, moss on the concrete, a faded sign: Line Zero.

t.zh: 所有的门同时打开。车厢里的人一个接一个地停住了，像被按了暂停键的录像。只有我还能动。
t.en: Every door opens at once. One by one the passengers stop, like a paused recording. Only I can move.

t.zh: 时间减速，一百倍。普通人感觉不到。
t.en: Time slowed a hundredfold. Ordinary people won't notice.

t.zh: 林栖小姐。我们是雷恩兄弟。我们要你的灯。
t.en: Miss Lin. We're the Rhine brothers. We want your lamp.

t.zh: 镜面上白光一闪——是我自己在摩天轮下的修复术。光照在车厢壁上，钢板变回了铁锭，玻璃变回了沙子。
t.en: White light flashes on the mirror—my own mending from under the wheel. It hits the car wall: steel back to ingots, glass back to sand.

t.zh: 修复的反面，就是拆解。你自己不知道吧？包括人。
t.en: The flip side of mending is unmaking. Didn't know that, did you? People included.

t.zh: 那道光对准我胸口的瞬间，一道冷白色的刃从隧道深处劈过来，把它斩成了两截。
t.en: As the beam swings to my chest, a cold white blade cuts in from deeper in the tunnel and severs it in two.

t.zh: 闭嘴，躲好。你现在这个样子，一碰就碎。
t.en: Shut up and get behind me. In your state, one touch and you'll shatter.

t.zh: 我是来抢灯的。我要从她手里抢，不是从你们手里。
t.en: I'm here for the lamp. I'll take it from her—not from you.

t.zh: 哥，我减速他。
t.en: I'll slow him.

t.zh: 葛兰像掉进了一池子蜂蜜。镜子里，冷白色的光一闪——断剑斩摩天轮的那一刀，也被照下来了。
t.en: Gran is suddenly wading through honey. In the mirror, a cold white flash—the stroke that cut the wheel, copied too.

t.zh: 斩断连结。你自己的能力，尝尝看。
t.en: Severing. Have a taste of your own power.

text.zh: 哥！
text.en: Adam!

label.zh: “……提灯。拿吧。”（会交出关于妈妈的一段记忆）
label.en: '…Lamp. Take it.' (costs a memory of Mum)

text.zh: 洗得发白的蓝外套，袖口的补丁。我想，如果我忘了，那个本子还在。如果我不出手，这个人会失去一条腿。
text.en: The washed-out blue coat, the patch on the cuff. If I forget, the notebook will still be there. If I don't do this, he loses a leg.

t.zh: 洗得发白的蓝外套，袖口的补丁。我想，如果我忘了，那个本子还在。如果我不出手，这个人会失去一条腿。
t.en: The washed-out blue coat, the patch on the cuff. If I forget, the notebook will still be there. If I don't do this, he loses a leg.

t.zh: 灯火灌进他的腿里。拆解停住了，然后往回长：骨，肉，皮。
t.en: The light pours into his leg. The unmaking stops, then grows back: bone, flesh, skin.

t.zh: 我的手在一个冬天里。有人把它揣进一只口袋，口袋是暖的。是谁的口袋？
t.en: My hand is in a winter. Someone tucks it into a pocket, and the pocket is warm. Whose pocket?

t.zh: 第五段。妈妈的蓝外套。……对不起，林栖。我收下了。
t.en: The fifth. Mum's blue coat. …I'm sorry, Lin. I'll keep it.

t.zh: ……我来晚了。你已经做了。
t.en: …I'm too late. You've already done it.

label.zh: 给苏蔓打电话——摇篮能让伤口睡着
label.en: Call Su Man—the Cradle can put a wound to sleep

text.zh: 我拨了那个号码。她接得很快，像一直醒着。
text.en: I dial the number. She answers fast, as if she'd been awake all along.

t.zh: 我拨了那个号码。她接得很快，像一直醒着。
t.en: I dial the number. She answers fast, as if she'd been awake all along.

t.zh: 别动。交给我。摇篮，让他睡。
t.en: Don't move. Leave it to me. Cradle, let him sleep.

t.zh: 一种很温柔的感觉，像一首很久以前听过的摇篮曲。拆解停住了——不是被修好，是睡着了。
t.en: Something very gentle, like a lullaby heard long ago. The unmaking stops—not mended. Asleep.

t.zh: 我本来下个月要去南边的海岛晒太阳，订好了机票。现在我想不起来，我为什么想去了。
t.en: I was going south next month to lie in the sun on an island. Tickets booked. Now I can't remember why I wanted to go.

t.zh: 对未来的期待。我收下了。
t.en: Her hope for what's ahead. I have taken it.

label.zh: 按住他的腿，能修多少修多少，不交出去
label.en: Hold his leg and mend what I can—without giving anything up

text.zh: 我修了一寸，又一寸。拆解停在大腿根的时候，我也停了，因为我已经没有力气了。
text.en: I mend an inch, then another. When the unmaking stops at his thigh, so do I. I have nothing left.

t.zh: 我修了一寸，又一寸。拆解停在大腿根的时候，我也停了，因为我已经没有力气了。
t.en: I mend an inch, then another. When the unmaking stops at his thigh, so do I. I have nothing left.

t.zh: ……谢谢。
t.en: …Thank you.

t.zh: 他背起弟弟，走进了隧道的黑暗里。本的左腿，从大腿往下，空空荡荡。
t.en: He hoists his brother on his back and walks into the dark. Below the thigh, Ben's left leg is gone.

t.zh: 哥！
t.en: Adam!

t.zh: 本扑过去，举起怀表——他不是要攻击，他是要把哥哥周围的时间停下来，伤就不会恶化。可那面镜子掉在地上，镜面朝上，正对着他。
t.en: Ben lunges, raising the watch—not to attack. To stop time around his brother, so the wound won't worsen. But the mirror lies face up on the ground, right in his path.

t.zh: 镜子里还残留着一道光。最后一道：我的拆解。
t.en: One light is left in the mirror. The last: my unmaking.

t.zh: 他的左腿，从膝盖往下，开始像沙子一样往下掉。
t.en: His left leg, from the knee down, begins to fall away like sand.
Ben—!

t.zh: 我扑过去，手按在他膝盖上。太快了。那是我自己的力量，失去了控制。我修好一寸，它就拆掉两寸。
t.en: I throw myself down, hands on his knee. Too fast. My own power, out of control. For every inch I mend it unmakes two.

t.zh: 林栖，你要是全力出手，我会拿走很重的东西。也许是她。
t.en: Lin, if you go all out, I'll take something heavy. Maybe her.

t.zh: 哥……对不起……
t.en: Adam… sorry…

title.zh: 〇号线隧道 · 打完以后

text.zh: 列车里，时间重新开始流动。车门关上了，列车缓缓开走，朝着有光的地方。隧道里只剩下我和葛兰。
text.en: In the train, time flows again. The doors close and it pulls away slowly, toward the light. Only Gran and I are left in the tunnel.

label.en: Tuck the beer into my coat pocket

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 列车里，时间重新开始流动。车门关上了，列车缓缓开走，朝着有光的地方。隧道里只剩下我和葛兰。
t.en: In the train, time flows again. The doors close and it pulls away slowly, toward the light. Only Gran and I are left in the tunnel.

t.zh: 你刚才，为了一个刚刚要杀你的人，打算全力出手。
t.en: Just now you were ready to go all out for someone who'd just tried to kill you.

t.zh: 六十年前的事，我不在乎了。断剑说，她想死。我要赢，是为了替她说那句话。
t.en: I'm done caring about sixty years ago. The Sword says she wants to die. I'm winning so I can say that for her.

t.zh: 那我们是敌人。
t.en: Then we're enemies.

t.zh: 是敌人。
t.en: Enemies.

t.zh: 那你刚才为什么救我？
t.en: Then why did you save me?

t.zh: ……因为你在涂鸦街说，你怕忘了你妈。我祖父忘了断剑，擦了二十年空匣子。
t.en: …Because on Mural Street you said you were afraid of forgetting your mum. My grandfather forgot the Sword and polished an empty case for twenty years.

t.zh: 他没回答完。他站起来，往隧道深处走，走了几步，从兜里掏出一样东西往后一扔。是一瓶没开的啤酒。
t.en: He doesn't finish. He gets up, walks deeper into the tunnel, and a few steps on tosses something back over his shoulder. An unopened beer.

t.zh: 打完再喝。不管谁赢。
t.en: Drink it when it's over. Whoever wins.

t.zh: ……你交朋友的方式真奇怪。
t.en: …You make friends in the strangest way.

t.zh: 他不是朋友。
t.en: He's not a friend.

t.zh: 嗯。敌人。
t.en: Mm. An enemy.

title.en: Top of the clock tower · 23:00 (the man with the umbrella)

text.zh: 棋盘上，白色的骑士和黑色的车，原本隔着整个棋盘对峙。现在它们挨在了一起，面对着那枚金红色的皇后。
text.en: On the board the white knight and the black rook used to face each other across the whole board. Now they stand side by side, facing the red-gold queen.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 棋盘上，白色的骑士和黑色的车，原本隔着整个棋盘对峙。现在它们挨在了一起，面对着那枚金红色的皇后。
t.en: On the board the white knight and the black rook used to face each other across the whole board. Now they stand side by side, facing the red-gold queen.

t.zh: 棋盘最底下一行，最角落的格子里，一枚他从来没有摆过的棋子自己立了起来。灰色的，像是用灰烬捏成的，没有形状。
t.en: In the bottom row, in the corner square, a piece he never placed stands up by itself. Grey, as if pressed out of ash, without a shape.

t.zh: 棋盘开口了。可那不是棋盘的声音。是一个女孩的声音，很轻，在笑。
t.en: The board speaks. But it isn't the board's voice. It is a girl's, light, laughing.

t.zh: “梅洛，你还记得你答应过我什么吗？”
t.en: 'Merlo, do you remember what you promised me?'

t.zh: ……我答应过什么？
t.en: …What did I promise?

t.zh: 钟楼的钟敲响了十一点。他想不起来。他什么都想不起来。
t.en: The tower strikes eleven. He can't remember. He can't remember anything.

title.zh: 艾希大厦楼下 · 黄昏（伊芙琳）

text.zh: 墨水瓶写下了一行字，墨迹还没有干：明晚十二点，钟楼之下。所有遗器持有者，来见我。
text.en: The Inkwell has written a line, the ink still wet: Midnight tomorrow, beneath the clock tower. Every relic holder, come and see me.

text.zh: （继续）
text.en: (Continue)

t.zh: 墨水瓶写下了一行字，墨迹还没有干：明晚十二点，钟楼之下。所有遗器持有者，来见我。
t.en: The Inkwell has written a line, the ink still wet: Midnight tomorrow, beneath the clock tower. Every relic holder, come and see me.

t.zh: 您确定吗，我的小姐？这是宣战。现在宣战，所有人都会联合起来对付您。
t.en: Are you sure, my lady? This is a declaration of war. Declare now and everyone will unite against you.

t.zh: 那就让他们来。我要所有人都看着。看着我赢。
t.en: Then let them. I want everyone watching. Watching me win.

t.zh: 诗人没有告诉她：她说出“我要所有人都看着”的时候，荆棘冠又悄悄拿走了一点东西。她已经快不记得，自己为什么想让所有人看着了。
t.en: The poet doesn't tell her: as she said 'I want everyone watching', the Crown quietly took a little more. She can barely remember why she wants anyone to watch.

text.zh: 灯芯上的火苗小得像一粒米。我用软布擦着黄铜的框架，擦到灯座底下的时候，手指摸到了一道刻痕。
text.en: The flame on the wick is the size of a grain of rice. I polish the brass frame with a soft cloth, and under the base my finger finds a groove.

label.en: Reach out and part the bands

text.zh: 光带烫得像烙铁。我拨开了一条——只看见本子封皮上的一行字：给六十年后，那个比我更勇敢的人。
text.en: The bands burn like irons. I part one—and see only a line on the notebook's cover: To the one, sixty years on, who is braver than I was.

t.zh: 光带烫得像烙铁。我拨开了一条——只看见本子封皮上的一行字：给六十年后，那个比我更勇敢的人。
t.en: The bands burn like irons. I part one—and see only a line on the notebook's cover: To the one, sixty years on, who is braver than I was.

t.zh: 然后光带合上了，把我推了出来。
t.en: Then the bands close, and push me out.

t.zh: ……她让我答应她两件事。替她保管好，一直到最后。还有，不要让你看见。
t.en: …She made me promise two things. Keep it safe until the end. And don't let you see.

text.zh: 我把手收了回来。光带上的白光一明一暗，像在呼吸。
text.en: I draw my hand back. The white bands brighten and dim, as if breathing.

t.zh: 我把手收了回来。光带上的白光一明一暗，像在呼吸。
t.en: I draw my hand back. The white bands brighten and dim, as if breathing.

t.zh: ……谢谢。
t.en: …Thank you.

t.zh: 苏蔓打电话来：“本醒了。腿是好的。他哥哥守在床边，三天没合眼。本醒过来，第一句话是问他哥哥吃饭了没有。”
t.en: Su Man calls: 'Ben's awake. The leg is fine. His brother hasn't slept in three days. The first thing Ben asked was whether his brother had eaten.'

t.zh: 苏蔓打电话来：“本醒了。左腿没了。本醒过来，第一句话是问他哥哥吃饭了没有。……林栖，那不是你的错。”
t.en: Su Man calls: 'Ben's awake. The left leg is gone. The first thing he asked was whether his brother had eaten. …Lin, it isn't your fault.'

t.zh: 灯芯上的火苗小得像一粒米。我用软布擦着黄铜的框架，擦到灯座底下的时候，手指摸到了一道刻痕。
t.en: The flame on the wick is the size of a grain of rice. I polish the brass frame with a soft cloth, and under the base my finger finds a groove.

t.zh: 灯座底下，刻得很潦草：M. & S.
t.en: Under the base, scratched in a hurry: M. & S.

t.zh: 我闭上眼睛，用修复术去“看”那盏灯的里面。我这辈子从来没有这样做过。
t.en: I close my eyes and use the mending to look inside the lamp. I've never done that in my life.

t.zh: 无边无际的黑暗里，飘着一盏一盏的灯，像一片倒过来的星空。每一盏灯里面，都有画面在流动。被提灯收下的、所有主人的、所有温暖的记忆。
t.en: In boundless dark float lanterns, one after another, like an upside-down sky. Pictures move inside each. Every warm memory the Lamp has ever taken from every holder.

t.zh: 离我最近的一盏：梧桐树，天蓝色的小自行车。扶着车座跑的是一个戴黑框眼镜、穿着沾了机油的工作服的男人。“栖栖，看前面！爸爸不松手——”
t.en: The nearest: the plane tree, the little sky-blue bike. The one running behind is a man in black-framed glasses and an oil-stained work shirt. 'Qiqi, look ahead! Daddy won't let go—'

t.zh: 是父亲。不是母亲。我看见了，可心里什么都没有。像在看一部别人的电影。
t.en: Dad. Not Mum. I can see it, and feel nothing. Like watching someone else's film.

t.zh: 一盏灯里是拆开的闹钟和一只大手。
t.en: In one lantern, a clock in pieces and a big hand.

t.zh: 一盏灯里是梧桐树底下的八音盒。
t.en: In one, a music box under the plane tree.

t.zh: 一盏灯里冒着热气，是一碗汤。
t.en: In one, steam rising from a bowl of soup.

t.zh: 一盏灯里是一只蓝色的口袋，口袋里揣着一只小手。
t.en: In one, a blue pocket with a small hand tucked inside.

t.zh: 黑暗最深的地方，悬着一盏被锁住的灯。四周缠着一圈一圈白色的光带。缝隙里漏出蓝色的光。
t.en: In the deepest dark hangs one lantern, locked. White bands wrap it round and round. Blue light leaks through the gaps.

t.zh: 我从缝隙里看见了一只袖子。洗得发白的蓝外套，左边袖口一块补丁。一只手握着笔，在一本很厚很厚的本子上写字。
t.en: Through a gap I see a sleeve. A washed-out blue coat, a patch on the left cuff. A hand holding a pen, writing in a very thick notebook.

t.zh: ……妈妈？
t.en: …Mum?

t.zh: 别碰。林栖，求你了。
t.en: Don't touch it. Lin, please.

text.zh: 那盏被锁起来的灯里面，是我妈妈。你为什么有她的记忆？她也是你的主人？
text.en: The locked lantern has my mother inside. Why do you have her memories? Was she your holder too?

label.zh: “我不会再全力出手了。我去交朋友。”
label.en: 'I won't go all out anymore. I'll make friends.'

text.zh: 我把那瓶没开的啤酒放在柜台上。
text.en: I set the unopened beer on the counter.

t.zh: 我把那瓶没开的啤酒放在柜台上。
t.en: I set the unopened beer on the counter.

t.zh: 这是灰烬王冠之争。十二件遗器，五个家族，所有人都想赢。没有人会跟你交朋友。
t.en: This is the Ashen Crown war. Twelve relics, five families, everyone wants to win. No one will be your friend.

t.zh: 葛兰会。苏蔓会。也许白秋也会，只要我能弄清楚她要什么。伊芙琳不知道自己要什么。我想帮她想出来。
t.en: Gran will. Su Man will. Maybe Bai Qiu too, once I figure out what she wants. Evelyn doesn't know what she wants. I'd like to help her find out.

t.zh: 我伸出手，摸了摸他透明的、银白色的头发。就像很多年前，有人摸我的头那样。
t.en: I reach out and touch his transparent silver hair. The way someone touched mine, many years ago.

t.zh: 我不恨你。你替我记着那个下午，替我记着爸爸，替我记着妈妈。谢谢你，提灯。
t.en: I don't hate you. You remember that afternoon for me, and Dad, and Mum. Thank you, Lamp.

t.zh: 灯芯上那粒米大的火苗，忽然跳了起来。很轻，很慢，像一个人在黑暗里，深深地吸了一口气。
t.en: The rice-grain flame on the wick suddenly rises. Lightly, slowly, like someone in the dark drawing a deep breath.

label.zh: “我要赢。只要能走到王冠面前，你拿什么都行。”
label.en: 'I'm going to win. If it gets me to the Crown, take whatever you want.'

text.zh: ……你知道我为什么只拿温暖的记忆吗？因为最不舍得。我拿得越重，你就越恨我。你越恨我，我就越不用……
text.en: …Do you know why I only take warm memories? Because they're the hardest to give. The heavier I take, the more you'll hate me. The more you hate me, the less I have to…

t.zh: ……你知道我为什么只拿温暖的记忆吗？因为最不舍得。我拿得越重，你就越恨我。你越恨我，我就越不用……
t.en: …Do you know why I only take warm memories? Because they're the hardest to give. The heavier I take, the more you'll hate me. The more you hate me, the less I have to…

t.zh: 越不用什么？
t.en: The less you have to what?

t.zh: 他低下头，没有回答。
t.en: He lowers his head and doesn't answer.

t.zh: 那盏被锁起来的灯里面，是我妈妈。你为什么有她的记忆？她也是你的主人？
t.en: The locked lantern has my mother inside. Why do you have her memories? Was she your holder too?

t.zh: 我答应过她。她说，你看见了，就会去找她。她不想让你去找她。
t.en: I promised her. She said if you saw, you'd go looking for her. She didn't want you to.

t.zh: ……她还活着吗？我只问这一个。
t.en: …Is she alive? That's all I'm asking.

t.zh: 我不知道。她把东西交给我，然后就不见了。我和你一样，林栖。我只记得她，却不知道她去了哪里。
t.en: I don't know. She gave it to me, and then she was gone. I'm like you, Lin. I remember her and don't know where she went.

t.zh: 等你站在王冠面前，我就把它还给你。
t.en: When you stand before the Crown, I'll give it back to you.

t.zh: 我拿出那个硬皮本子。第一页写着：我的母亲叫林遥。
t.en: I take out the hardback notebook. Page one: My mother's name is Lin Yao.

t.zh: 我把“她不会骑自行车”那一行划掉，在下面写：扶我学骑车的，是爸爸。我已经不记得了。但是提灯替我记得。
t.en: I strike out 'She can't ride a bike' and write beneath: The one who taught me to ride was Dad. I don't remember anymore. But the Lamp remembers for me.

text.zh: 那一行字出现在了啤酒瓶的标签上。原本印着“维斯特林精酿”的地方：明晚十二点，钟楼之下。所有遗器持有者，来见我。
text.en: The line appeared on the beer bottle's label, where it used to say 'Westerling Craft': Midnight tomorrow, beneath the clock tower. Every relic holder, come and see me.

label.zh: “你已经想不起来，为什么要让所有人看着你了，对吧？”
label.en: 'You can't remember anymore why you want everyone watching, can you?'

text.zh: ……这和你没关系。
text.en: …That's none of your business.

t.zh: ……这和你没关系。
t.en: …That's none of your business.

t.zh: 你叫我们所有人来，让我们看着你赢。赢了以后呢？你为什么要让所有人看着？
t.en: You called us all here to watch you win. After that? Why do you need everyone watching?

t.zh: 她的手指在手套里蜷了一下。她想说“因为我要让他们承认我”，可这句话到了嘴边，变得很陌生，像一句别人说过的话。
t.en: Her fingers curl inside her gloves. She wants to say 'because I want them to acknowledge me', but at her lips it turns strange, like something someone else once said.

t.zh: ……修灯的。你很烦。
t.en: …Lamp-mender. You're a nuisance.

t.zh: 我知道。很多人都这么说。
t.en: I know. A lot of people say so.

label.zh: “你上次说还没想好要改什么。现在想好了吗？”
label.en: 'Last time you hadn't decided what to change. Have you now?'

text.zh: 赢了以后，我再想。
text.en: I'll think about it after I win.

t.zh: 赢了以后，我再想。
t.en: I'll think about it after I win.

t.zh: 那你现在为什么要让所有人看着？
t.en: Then why do you need everyone watching now?

t.zh: ……修灯的，你很烦。
t.en: …Lamp-mender, you're a nuisance.

label.zh: 什么都不说，抬头看那顶荆棘王冠
label.en: Say nothing; look up at the crown of thorns

text.zh: 月光从荆棘的缝隙里漏下来，在广场上投下一片斑驳的、带刺的影子。所有人都仰着头。
text.en: Moonlight leaks through the thorns and throws a dappled, spiked shadow across the plaza. Everyone is looking up.

t.zh: 月光从荆棘的缝隙里漏下来，在广场上投下一片斑驳的、带刺的影子。所有人都仰着头。
t.en: Moonlight leaks through the thorns and throws a dappled, spiked shadow across the plaza. Everyone is looking up.

t.zh: 那一行字出现在了啤酒瓶的标签上。原本印着“维斯特林精酿”的地方：明晚十二点，钟楼之下。所有遗器持有者，来见我。
t.en: The line appeared on the beer bottle's label, where it used to say 'Westerling Craft': Midnight tomorrow, beneath the clock tower. Every relic holder, come and see me.

t.zh: 广场被清空了：“钟楼夜间检修”。白秋和她的双生子，葛兰和断剑，苏蔓和摇篮，戴耳机的亚当，两手空空的卡罗。还有扣着最上面一颗扣子的奥古斯特。
t.en: The plaza has been cleared: 'Clock tower closed for night maintenance'. Bai Qiu and her twins, Gran and the Sword, Su Man and the Cradle, Adam in his headphones, Carlo with empty hands. And August, buttoned to the top.

t.zh: 你紧张什么？你烟都快被你嚼烂了。
t.en: What are you nervous about? You've chewed that cigarette to pulp.

t.zh: 葛兰隔着半个广场看了我一眼，把那支被嚼烂的烟扔进了垃圾桶，别过了脸。
t.en: Across half the plaza Gran glances at me, tosses the chewed cigarette in the bin and looks away.

t.zh: 钟楼的钟敲响了十二点。
t.en: The clock tower strikes twelve.

t.zh: 第一声钟响，伊芙琳从钟楼顶上走了下来。不是走楼梯，是走在荆棘交织成的阶梯上。光着脚的长发少女在她身后飞；戴眼镜的书记员写下一行字：钟楼，停。
t.en: On the first stroke Evelyn descends from the top of the tower—not by stairs, but down a stair of woven thorns. A barefoot girl with long hair flies behind her; a bespectacled clerk writes a line: Clock, stop.

t.zh: 我会赢。
t.en: I will win.

t.zh: 那四个字变成了四根古树一样的巨大荆棘，撞碎了广场的石板，长到钟楼的高度，在尖顶上空交织成了一顶漆黑的、带刺的冠冕。
