t.en: Those words become four thorns as thick as ancient trees. They shatter the paving, grow to the height of the tower and weave above the spire into a black crown of thorns.

t.zh: 她每一次出手，荆棘冠都会拿走她的骄傲。她现在用得这么狠，应该已经没剩多少了。
t.en: Every time she strikes, the Crown takes her pride. Using it this hard, she can't have much left.

text.zh: 奥古斯特·莱恩感觉到西装内袋里多了一样东西。一个牛皮纸信封。里面是一张泛黄的纸：
text.en: August Lane feels something new in his inside pocket. A brown envelope. Inside, a yellowed page:

text.zh: 钟楼的钟敲响了十二点十分。那一声很长，很长，在维斯特林的上空回荡了很久。像是一场漫长的战争，终于真正地，开始了。
text.en: The tower strikes ten past twelve. The note is long, so long, ringing over Westerling for a great while. As if a long war has finally, truly begun.

t.zh: 钟楼的钟敲响了十二点十分。那一声很长，很长，在维斯特林的上空回荡了很久。像是一场漫长的战争，终于真正地，开始了。
t.en: The tower strikes ten past twelve. The note is long, so long, ringing over Westerling for a great while. As if a long war has finally, truly begun.

t.zh: 奥古斯特·莱恩感觉到西装内袋里多了一样东西。一个牛皮纸信封。里面是一张泛黄的纸：
t.en: August Lane feels something new in his inside pocket. A brown envelope. Inside, a yellowed page:

t.zh: 第六次灰烬王冠之争，胜者：梅洛。改写的规则：（此处字迹被抹去）。规则生效后，确认被遗忘者名单如下——
t.en: Sixth Ashen Crown War. Victor: Merlo. Rule rewritten: (this line erased). Confirmed forgotten after the rule took effect:

t.zh: 7. 苏（姓氏不详）——提灯持有者。……最后一个名字，墨迹比其他的都新：林遥——十一年前。
t.en: 7. Su (surname unknown)—holder of the Lamp. …The last name, in fresher ink than the rest: Lin Yao—eleven years ago.

t.zh: 他抬起头，隔着整个广场，看向我。他找了四十一年的东西，就这样，被人塞进了他的口袋里。
t.en: He looks up, across the whole plaza, at me. What he spent forty-one years looking for has simply been slipped into his pocket.

t.zh: 伊芙琳打了一个响指。钟楼的指针重新开始走了。只有那顶荆棘王冠还悬在夜空里。
t.en: Evelyn snaps her fingers. The clock hands move again. Only the crown of thorns still hangs in the night sky.

t.zh: 诸位，我给大家七天的时间。七天以后，我会从你们每一个人手里，把遗器拿过来。一个一个地，按我的顺序。
t.en: Everyone, I give you seven days. In seven days I will take your relics from each of you. One by one, in my order.

t.zh: 修灯的，你是第一个。
t.en: Lamp-mender. You're first.

t.zh: 我的手慢慢地握住了腰上的提灯。灯是暖的。
t.en: My hand slowly closes on the lamp at my belt. It's warm.

title.en: Bad End: Ash in the Basement

text.zh: 拱顶塌下来。第二天，林记修复的卷帘门没有拉开。没有人记得那家铺子原本是谁开的。
text.en: The vault falls. Next day Lin's Repairs doesn't open. No one remembers who used to run it.

clinic.zh: 灰色诊所里，戴圆框眼镜的医生推了推眼镜：“拒绝契约没有错，错在时机。那一晚，断剑已经找上门了。先活下来，代价以后再谈。——回到地下室，接受契约。”
clinic.en: In the grey clinic, the doctor in round glasses pushes them up: 'Refusing the pact isn't wrong; the timing is. That night the Sword was already at the door. Live first; argue about the price later. —Go back to the basement and accept.'

text.zh: 灯还在，契约断了。葛兰拎走了提灯。你回到铺子里，想不起来自己为什么要去祖宅。
text.en: The lamp survives; the pact doesn't. Gran takes the Lamp. Back at the shop you can't remember why you went to the old house.

clinic.zh: 穿蓝外套的女人坐在诊所的柜台后面：“断剑斩的是连结，挡是挡不住的。要么接回去，要么让她不想砍。你读过葛兰那一夜吗？”
clinic.en: A woman in a blue coat sits behind the clinic counter: 'The Sword cuts connections; you can't block that. Either join it again, or make her not want to cut. Did you read Gran's night?'

text.zh: 星期日乐园的招牌上，“日”字三十年前就掉了。那一夜以后，摩天轮底下又多了一堆废铁。你没有灯了。
text.en: The 'Sunday' sign lost its last letters thirty years ago. After that night there's one more heap of scrap under the wheel. You no longer have a lamp.

clinic.zh: 戴圆框眼镜的医生：“躲开没有用，那是几十吨的钢。要么全力，要么找到所有连结的根。下午去看过场地吗？”
clinic.en: The doctor in round glasses: 'Dodging won't work; that's tons of steel. Go all out, or find the root of every link. Did you look at the ground that afternoon?'

text.zh: 线断了。灯落进蓝色的油漆里，再也没有亮。那一夜以后，你又变回了一个只会修收音机的人。
text.en: The line is cut. The lamp falls into the blue paint and never lights again. After that night you're just someone who fixes radios.

clinic.zh: 戴圆框眼镜的医生：“断剑砍的是连结。把背留给他，就是把线留给他。你见过他砍摩天轮——他从来先砍什么？”
clinic.en: The doctor in round glasses: 'The Sword cuts links. Turn your back on him and you hand him the line. You saw him at the wheel—what does he always cut first?'

text.zh: 〇号线又封上了。守秘局的报告里写着：信号故障，无人受伤。提灯那一栏，持有者变成了“雷恩，A.”。
text.en: Line Zero is sealed again. The Bureau report reads: signal fault, no injuries. On the Lamp's line, the holder now reads 'Rhine, A.'

clinic.zh: 戴圆框眼镜的医生：“镜子只会照它见过的东西。你修过什么，它没见过？——还有，那两兄弟，读过他们的那一夜吗？”
clinic.en: The doctor in round glasses: 'The mirror can only copy what it has seen. What could you mend that it has never seen? And those brothers—did you read their night?'

text.zh: 荆棘王冠悬在维斯特林的夜空里。伊芙琳给了所有人七天，而你是第一个。灯是暖的。卷二《结盟》，从这七天开始。
text.en: The crown of thorns hangs over Westerling. Evelyn has given everyone seven days, and you are first. The lamp is warm. Volume 2, Alliance, begins with those seven days.

text.zh: 记忆册里一页都没有变灰。你学会了在不全力的时候，也能把东西修好。
text.en: Not one page of the memory book has gone grey. You learned to mend things without going all out.

text.zh: 记忆册里有几页变灰了。你知道那里写过很温暖的事，只是想不起来是什么。
text.en: A few pages of the memory book have gone grey. You know something warm was written there; you can't recall what.

text.zh: 记忆册里大半都变灰了。最后剩下的那一页，是港口的照片：照片上你身边是一片空白，可你记得那里站着她。
text.en: Most of the memory book has gone grey. The last page left is the photo at the harbor: a blank beside you, but you remember she stood there.

text.zh: 葛兰在摩天轮底下说：下回打架，叫上我。你没想到自己会记住这句话。
text.en: Under the Ferris wheel Gran said: next time there's a fight, call me. You didn't expect to remember that.

text.zh: 葛兰还是你的对手。他扔给你的那瓶啤酒，你还没有开。
text.en: Gran is still your opponent. The beer he tossed you is still unopened.

text.zh: 本出院那天是走着出去的。亚当在医院门口站了很久，什么都没说，冲你鞠了一躬。
text.en: Ben walked out of the hospital on his own feet. Adam stood at the door a long time, said nothing, and bowed to you.

text.zh: 本的左腿没了。你在工具包里翻出一盒弹簧和齿轮，想了很久，能不能给他修一条腿。
text.en: Ben lost his left leg. You turned out a box of springs and gears from your tool bag and wondered for a long time whether you could mend him a leg.

text.zh: 苏蔓的名片压在柜台的玻璃底下。她还是每天打一个电话来，问你吃药了没有。
text.en: Su Man's card sits under the counter glass. She still calls every day to ask if you've taken your pills.

text.zh: 苏蔓说过，她想阻止王冠被打开。你没告诉她你妈妈的事。也许下一次。
text.en: Su Man said she wants to stop the Crown opening. You didn't tell her about your mum. Next time, maybe.

text.zh: 伊芙琳走回夜空之前，最后看了你一眼。那一眼里，好像有一个她自己也答不上来的问题。
text.en: Before Evelyn walked back into the sky she looked at you one last time. As if there were a question in it she couldn't answer either.

text.zh: 伊芙琳踩着荆棘的阶梯走回夜空，没有回头。
text.en: Evelyn walked back up her stair of thorns into the sky without looking back.

side_prompt.zh: 这一夜，城里不止你一个人醒着。读谁的？
side_prompt.en: Tonight you are not the only one awake in the city. Whose night will you read?

lighthouse.en: Top of the old north lighthouse

train.en: A train stopped in the tunnel

cg_wheel.en: The wheel that turned on its own

cg_t_watch.en: The clock and the younger brother

title.en: The afternoon I learned to ride

text.zh: 院子里的梧桐树，一辆天蓝色的小自行车。有个人在后面扶着车座跟着跑，然后松了手。
text.en: The plane tree in the yard, a little sky-blue bicycle. Someone ran behind holding the seat, then let go.

title.en: The first time Dad praised my hands

text.zh: 台灯下拆开的闹钟。它重新走起来的时候，一只带着机油味的大手揉了揉我的头。
text.en: An alarm clock in pieces under the desk lamp. When it ticked again, a big hand that smelled of machine oil ruffled my hair.

text.zh: 五岁，蹲在梧桐树底下修了一整个下午。妈妈叫我吃饭，我说它现在就坏着，它现在就难受。
text.en: Five years old, squatting under the plane tree all afternoon. Mum called me in to eat; I said it's broken right now, it hurts right now.

text.zh: 洗得发白，左边袖口有一块她自己缝的补丁，针脚歪歪扭扭。冬天她把我的手揣进口袋里。
text.en: Washed pale, a patch she sewed herself on the left cuff, crooked stitches. In winter she tucked my hands into its pocket.

text.zh: 每次都咸，她自己从来不觉得。
text.en: Salty every single time; she never noticed.

text.zh: 我举着手去够海鸥。照片上我身边那一块是空白——可我记得那里站着她。
text.en: I'm reaching for a gull. Beside me in the photo is a blank—but I remember she stood there.

text.zh: 林栖
text.en: Lin Qi

text.zh: 修复：让坏掉的东西想起原本的样子。
text.en: Mending: makes broken things remember what they were.

text.zh: 温暖的记忆，由提灯挑。
text.en: Warm memories, chosen by the Lamp.

text.zh: 两个字母：M. & S.
text.en: Two letters: M. & S.

text.zh: 苏（姓氏不详）。名字在第六次王冠之争的被遗忘者名单上。
text.en: Su (surname unknown). Her name is on the list of the forgotten from the sixth Crown war.

text.zh: 里面是一件蓝外套和一本很厚的本子。“给六十年后，那个比我更勇敢的人。”
text.en: Inside, a blue coat and a very thick notebook. 'To the one, sixty years on, who is braver than I was.'

text.zh: （卷一里不会揭晓）
text.en: (not revealed in Volume 1)

text.zh: 葛兰·霍克
text.en: Gran Hawke

text.zh: 斩断连结：术式、契约、因果。
text.en: Severing: spells, contracts, causes.

text.zh: 六十年前断的。白秋说，是提灯的上一任主人折断的——真假不知道。
text.en: Broken sixty years ago. Bai Qiu says the Lamp's last holder broke it—true or not, unknown.

text.zh: “等到第六十年，帮我一个忙。”
text.en: 'In the sixtieth year, do me a favor.'

text.zh: 她想死。真正地死。只有王冠能改写“遗器不会死”这条规则。
text.en: She wants to die. Truly. Only the Crown can rewrite the rule that relics never die.

text.zh: 阿尔伯特·霍克，葛兰的祖父。输了以后，擦了二十年空匣子。
text.en: Albert Hawke, Gran's grandfather. After he lost, he polished an empty case for twenty years.

text.zh: 伊芙琳·冯·艾希
text.en: Evelyn von Eiche

text.zh: 一个捧着空白书的诗人。
text.en: A poet holding a blank book.

text.zh: 卡罗·文斯手里的墨水瓶。
text.en: Carlo Vince's Inkwell.

text.zh: 关于她自己的骄傲。每赢一次，就少一点。
text.en: Her pride in herself. A little less with every win.

text.zh: 荆棘冠、墨水瓶、风筝。三件。
text.en: Thorn Crown, Inkwell, Kite. Three.

text.zh: 白秋
text.en: Bai Qiu

text.zh: 交换：两件事物的重量、位置，甚至命运。
text.en: Exchange: the weight, place, even fate of two things.

text.zh: 做选择时的犹豫。
text.en: Hesitation when choosing.

text.zh: 被太重的东西压裂的。林栖修好了它。
text.en: Cracked by something too heavy. Lin mended it.

text.zh: （未登记）
text.en: (unregistered)

text.zh: 最底下一行，最角落。没有形状，像灰烬捏成的。它用一个女孩的声音说话。
text.en: Bottom row, corner square. Shapeless, as if pressed from ash. It speaks in a girl's voice.

text.zh: 第六次灰烬王冠之争，胜者：梅洛。
text.en: Sixth Ashen Crown War. Victor: Merlo.

text.zh: 雷恩，A.
text.en: Rhine, A.

text.zh: 照下别人的术式，再放出来，威力只有一半。只会照它见过的东西。
text.en: Copies a spell it has seen and casts it back at half strength. Only what it has seen.

text.zh: 雷恩，B.
text.en: Rhine, B.

text.zh: 时间的顺序。
text.en: The order of time.
(none)
(none)

text.zh: 伊芙琳·冯·艾希。器灵是一个光着脚的长发少女。
text.en: Evelyn von Eiche. Its spirit is a barefoot girl with long hair.

text.zh: 卡罗·文斯
text.en: Carlo Vince

text.zh: 写下来的东西会暂时成真。得先写。
text.en: What is written comes true for a while. It must be written first.

text.zh: 伊芙琳·冯·艾希。
text.en: Evelyn von Eiche.
(none)

text.zh: 苏蔓。她三个月前在医院地下室捡到的，从没登记。
text.en: Su Man. She found it in the hospital basement three months ago and never registered it.

text.zh: 对未来的期待。
text.en: Hope for what's ahead.

text.zh: 这一栏是空白。不是“空”，也不是“未登记”。
text.en: This line is blank. Not 'none', not 'unregistered'.

text.zh: 四百二十年来，钥匙那一栏从来没有填过。可是每一次王冠打开，都要用到它。
text.en: In four hundred and twenty years the Key's line has never been filled. Yet every time the Crown opens, it is used.
